quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا
إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًۭا ثَقِيلًا
إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًۭٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًۭا طَوِيلًۭا
وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًۭا
رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًۭا
وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًۭا جَمِيلًۭا
وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًۭا وَجَحِيمًۭا
وَطَعَامًۭا ذَا غُصَّةٍۢ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًۭا مَّهِيلًا
إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًۭا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًۭا
فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ أَخْذًۭا وَبِيلًۭا
فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًۭا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا

۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍۢ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًۭا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًۭا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۢ

parent_channels.name: P1 - Measured Night Formation

subchannels.name: Partitioning the night
subchannels.scene_or_process: A night interval is divided, reduced, or enlarged while the practitioner rises within it.
subchannels.active_motifs: night and its darkness (`quranic:root_001392:B001/m01`); nighttime activity (`quranic:root_001392:B002/m01`); bodily standing (`quranic:root_001273:B002/m01`); a small portion (`quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`); one half (`quranic:root_001511:B001/m01`); reaching the midpoint (`quranic:root_001511:B002/m01`); removal of part (`quranic:root_001542:B001/m01`); increase and growth (`quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The interval is treated as workable material. Standing supplies the operative posture, while fewness, half, decrease, and increase make the night a deliberately adjustable portion rather than an undifferentiated span.

subchannels.name: Calibrating weight and correspondence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Quantities and bodily-verbal contact are brought into balance, agreement, and stable proportion.
subchannels.active_motifs: known weight and measure (`quranic:root_000202:B004/m01`); equal weight and moderate quantity (`quranic:root_001273:B015/m01`); fairness and equal dealing (`quranic:root_001511:B003/m01`); thing-to-thing correspondence (`quranic:root_001659:B004/m01`); ordered alignment (`quranic:root_000540:B002/m01`); straightness and equilibrium (`quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The lexical field converts the regimen into calibration. Weight is matched to measure, half evokes equitable division, and the night’s stronger contact becomes correspondence among elements rather than pressure alone.

subchannels.name: Assembling and transmitting ordered speech
subchannels.scene_or_process: Discrete verbal material is gathered, articulated in sequence, delivered, and received as instruction.
subchannels.active_motifs: deliberate articulated recitation (`quranic:root_000540:B001/m01`); gathering parts into a whole (`quranic:root_001210:B001/m01`); reading and recitation (`quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`); collected wording and reading (`quranic:root_001211:B001/m01`); spoken utterance (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); receiving and learning words (`quranic:root_001372:B011/m01`); ear-heart-tongue agreement (`quranic:root_001659:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Recitation is an assembly line of signification: gathering precedes ordering, ordered wording is cast toward a recipient, and reception completes the process. The correspondence sense of `و ط ء` makes the result an alignment of hearing, inward grasp, and tongue.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A demanding practice is formed by partitioning duration, setting the body upright, and ordering speech into an exact sequence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:2-6 anchors `قُمِ`, `ٱلَّيْلَ`, `قَلِيلًا`, `نِّصْفَهُ`, `ٱنقُصْ`, `زِدْ`, `رَتِّلِ`, `قُرْءَانَ`, `قَوْلًا`, `وَطْـًٔا`, and `أَقْوَمُ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The time instructions behave not only as scheduling but as compositional work: subtracting, adding, balancing, gathering, and aligning a verbal whole.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Burden Transmission and Bodily Traction

subchannels.name: The wrapped load-bearer
subchannels.scene_or_process: A wrapped figure rises like a carrier who must brace under freight.
subchannels.active_motifs: wrapping oneself in clothes (`quranic:root_000644:B003/m01`); load and weight (`quranic:root_000644:B001/m01`); pillion and balanced riding (`quranic:root_000644:B002/m01`); an animal bearing forward on its forelegs (`quranic:root_000644:B005/m01`); lifting and carrying a load (`quranic:root_001251:B004/m01`); bodily standing (`quranic:root_001273:B002/m01`); undertaking an affair (`quranic:root_001273:B003/m01`); physical and semantic heaviness (`quranic:root_000202:B001/m01`); sluggish burdened movement (`quranic:root_000202:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Clothing, freight, riding balance, and braced gait converge on an embodied carrier. The address to the wrapped one is thereby pressured by a latent transport image: rising means assuming and stabilizing a load.

subchannels.name: Casting and receiving the weighty saying
subchannels.scene_or_process: A valuable, weight-bearing utterance is cast toward a hearer and taken up as learned speech.
subchannels.active_motifs: throwing something onto another (`quranic:root_001372:B005/m01`); spoken utterance (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); a precious thing or saying of weight (`quranic:root_000202:B005/m01`); receiving and learning words (`quranic:root_001372:B011/m01`); taking hold of spoken words (`quranic:root_000018:B001/m01`); heaviness in the ear (`quranic:root_000202:B009/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Delivery is simultaneously projectile transfer and instruction. The saying has precious weight, but that weight can also tax hearing, so successful reception requires active taking rather than passive exposure.

subchannels.name: Foot pressure becoming firm contact
subchannels.scene_or_process: A footfall presses down, meets resistance, and settles into a firm, congruent stance.
subchannels.active_motifs: foot treading a place (`quranic:root_001659:B001/m01`); severe pressure or seizure (`quranic:root_001659:B003/m01`); thing-to-thing agreement (`quranic:root_001659:B004/m01`); fastening and strengthening a bond (`quranic:root_000782:B001/m01`); force, solidity, and exertion (`quranic:root_000782:B002/m01`); upright stability (`quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The night’s “tread” unfolds as a mechanics of formation. Pressure alone would crush, but binding, solidity, and correspondence convert it into footing that can support straighter speech.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A load becomes effective when a carrier rises, braces, receives it, and converts pressure into stable contact.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:1-6 anchors `ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ`, `قُمِ`, `نُلْقِى`, `قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا`, `أَشَدُّ`, and `وَطْـًٔا`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The “heavy saying” is materialized as freight, pregnancy, impaired hearing, a thrown object, and the force of feet finding purchase.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Withdrawal and Reassigned Guardianship

subchannels.name: Severance directed toward an endpoint
subchannels.scene_or_process: A participant cuts loose from competing attachments and directs the separation toward a terminal relation.
subchannels.active_motifs: cutting and distinguishing one thing from another (`quranic:root_000082:B001/m01`); abstention from marital attachment (`quranic:root_000082:B003/m01`); a palm offshoot separated from its mother (`quranic:root_000082:B004/m01`); separation and bodily, verbal, or inward departure (`quranic:root_001578:B001/m01`); exile and removal from one’s place (`quranic:root_001077:B007/m01`); reaching an endpoint (`quranic:root_000076:B001/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 73:8 `تَبَتَّلْ/تَبْتِيلًا`; 73:9 `ٱلْمَغْرِبِ`; 73:10 `ٱهْجُرْهُمْ/هَجْرًا`; surface anchor unavailable for `quranic:root_000076:B001` because `ء ل ي` is missing from root coverage
subchannels.synthesis: The scene is not mere isolation. Like an offshoot that has become self-standing, separation removes dependency so movement can terminate in a newly exclusive attachment.

subchannels.name: Beautiful non-engagement
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hostile speech is met by restrained departure conducted with fairness and visible grace.
subchannels.active_motifs: holding the self back from panic or reaction (`quranic:root_000840:B001/m01`); leaving and distancing without continued exchange (`quranic:root_001578:B001/m01`); beauty in conduct and action (`quranic:root_000260:B004/m01`); fairness and equal dealing (`quranic:root_001511:B003/m01`); good reputation produced by conduct (`quranic:root_000516:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Departure is shaped as an ethical performance rather than a rupture driven by rage. Restraint, equitable dealing, and beauty specify the manner in which the relation is ended and the kind of public memory it leaves.

subchannels.name: Entrusting the released affair
subchannels.scene_or_process: What is no longer personally grasped is delegated to a sovereign caretaker who can preserve and discharge it.
subchannels.active_motifs: taking something as one’s own (`quranic:root_000018:B010/m01`); handing an affair to another (`quranic:root_001681:B001/m01`); reliance (`quranic:root_001681:B002/m01`); a sufficient guardian and guarantor (`quranic:root_001681:B006/m01`); ownership and sovereignty (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); repair, nurture, and completion (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); surety and accompanying responsibility (`quranic:root_000840:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: “Taking a guardian” reverses ordinary possession: the human act of taking installs another as the true holder of the affair. Sovereignty is joined to nurture and surety, distinguishing reliable guardianship from dependence that merely abandons responsibility.

subchannels.name: Failed delegation and exhausted dependence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Delegation fails when a weak dependent cannot bear its load, counterparties neglect one another, or a carrier lags and stops.
subchannels.active_motifs: a weak dependent (`quranic:root_001681:B003/m01`); mutual neglect after reciprocal delegation (`quranic:root_001681:B004/m01`); a lagging animal dependent on the herd (`quranic:root_001681:B005/m01`); a weak or deficient burden (`quranic:root_000644:B004/m01`); an exhausted animal stopping after travel (`quranic:root_001273:B016/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: These are failure cases for guardianship. A dependent needs support, but reciprocal abandonment leaves the load unattended; the lagging and exhausted animals show the bodily consequence when delegated support does not hold.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Cutting one relation does not leave a vacuum; the released affair is redirected toward an endpoint and entrusted to a keeper.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:8-10 anchors `تَبَتَّلْ`, `إِلَيْهِ`, `فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا`, `ٱصْبِرْ`, and `ٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Separation extends from severance and migration to a self-sufficient palm offshoot, while reliance is tested against failed mutual delegation and lagging dependence.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Speech From Inward Form to Public Circulation

subchannels.name: From inner saying to articulated sign
subchannels.scene_or_process: An inwardly held representation is externalized by the tongue and made to indicate or define an object.
subchannels.active_motifs: an unspoken saying in the self (`quranic:root_001272:B012/m01`); spoken utterance (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); the tongue as speech instrument (`quranic:root_001272:B002/m01`); a thing’s signifying “saying” (`quranic:root_001272:B014/m01`); a defining formulation (`quranic:root_001272:B016/m01`); inward recollection (`quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`); verbal mention (`quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Saying begins before sound and ends beyond it. Inward representation becomes tongue-borne wording, then functions as indication and definition, giving the commands to remember and recite a full cognitive-discursive depth.

subchannels.name: Rumor, fabrication, and verbal injury
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech detaches from verified reality, circulates among people, and wounds through false attribution or obscenity.
subchannels.active_motifs: habitual profuse talk (`quranic:root_001272:B003/m01`); saying what did not occur or attributing it falsely (`quranic:root_001272:B005/m01`); circulating public talk (`quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`); negotiation and verbal exchange (`quranic:root_001272:B009/m01`); obscene or injurious speech (`quranic:root_001578:B003/m01`); unintended delirious speech (`quranic:root_001578:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The opponents’ saying opens onto a whole circulation ecology: repetition, bargaining, false imputation, and abusive speech. Delirium marks the limiting case in which words continue while accountable intention has collapsed.

subchannels.name: Name, reminder, and reputation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Naming calls an absent referent into social presence and repeated mention stabilizes it as memory and reputation.
subchannels.active_motifs: name as designation (`quranic:root_000745:B005/m01`); memory restored and retained (`quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`); verbal mention (`quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`); reminder that restores presence (`quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`); public honor and reputation (`quranic:root_000516:B007/m01`); a good report spreading (`quranic:root_000745:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Remembering the name is a repeatable act that carries presence through time. The same machinery can create public repute, so private remembrance and social renown are related outcomes of sustained mention.

subchannels.name: Appropriating a saying as conviction
subchannels.scene_or_process: Received speech is taken inward, weighed as a supposition, and either adopted as doctrine or held with sincere concern.
subchannels.active_motifs: taking a saying inward as one’s own (`quranic:root_001272:B006/m01`); supposition and opinion (`quranic:root_001272:B011/m01`); belief or doctrine (`quranic:root_001272:B013/m01`); sincere concern expressed in speech (`quranic:root_001272:B015/m01`); receiving and learning words (`quranic:root_001372:B011/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: This scene separates hearing from assent. A saying can be received, entertained as an opinion, and appropriated as a settled conviction; sincere concern marks a morally different mode of inward uptake from rumor or fabrication.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A sign passes through inward conception, articulation, social circulation, and durable naming.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:4-10 anchors `رَتِّلِ`, `قَوْلًا`, `قِيلًا`, `ٱذْكُرِ`, `ٱسْمَ`, and `يَقُولُونَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Speech can become rumor, false attribution, delirium, doctrine, definition, reputation, or a document of right, so verbal pressure is also pressure over social reality.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Horizon Cycle and Traversal

subchannels.name: The horizon as a clock
subchannels.scene_or_process: Light rises, reaches its height, declines, and gives way to night, making direction a temporal measure.
subchannels.active_motifs: sunrise and the eastern direction (`quranic:root_000790:B001/m01`); sunset and the western direction (`quranic:root_001077:B006/m01`); night and darkness (`quranic:root_001392:B001/m01`); daylight opening in brightness (`quranic:root_001559:B002/m01`); the sun standing at noon (`quranic:root_001273:B017/m01`); the day at its height (`quranic:root_000782:B005/m01`); extended duration (`quranic:root_000959:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: East and west are temporal gates, while noon supplies a vertical midpoint. The cycle links nightly standing to a daylight arc whose length is read through the moving light.

subchannels.name: Riding through night and roaming by day
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler mounts the night, moves with companions, and uses the day’s breadth for livelihood.
subchannels.active_motifs: nighttime travel (`quranic:root_001392:B002/m01`); taking the night as a camel for continuous travel (`quranic:root_000260:B008/m01`); a camel herd (`quranic:root_000260:B001/m01`); swimming, running, or extended motion (`quranic:root_000666:B004/m01`); free movement for livelihood (`quranic:root_000666:B005/m01`); a traveling company (`quranic:root_000644:B009/m01`); travel provisions (`quranic:root_000657:B005/m01`); distance and estrangement (`quranic:root_001077:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The day-night contrast becomes a travel economy. Night is a mount to be ridden with endurance; day is open roaming for livelihood, supplied by provisions and exposed to distance from home.

subchannels.name: Sky movement and layered weather
subchannels.scene_or_process: High, layered clouds gather, persist, and move above the day-night route.
subchannels.active_motifs: sky, cloud, and what rises overhead (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`); layered rain cloud (`quranic:root_000532:B008/m01`); stacked white cloud (`quranic:root_000840:B010/m01`); cloud named `النَّاهُور` (`quranic:root_001559:B008/m01`); rising and elevation (`quranic:root_001502:B001/m01`); a high object visible at distance (`quranic:root_000745:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Elevation links the night’s rising to meteorological formation. Persisting cloud layers supply a visible model of accumulation above the horizontal journey, turning temporal endurance into a sky-borne structure.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Time is perceived as movement across a bounded expanse, whether by sun, traveler, swimmer, mount, or caravan.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:2, 7, and 9 anchor `ٱلَّيْلَ`, `ٱلنَّهَارِ`, `سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا`, `ٱلْمَشْرِقِ`, and `ٱلْمَغْرِبِ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The long daytime “swim” becomes both livelihood-roaming and a transport scene in which the night itself is ridden as a camel.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Water Capture and Conveyance

subchannels.name: Well, bucket, trough, and reservoir
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water is drawn from a well, caught in a vessel, and retained in a trough or basin.
subchannels.active_motifs: a large well bucket (`quranic:root_001077:B002/m01`); water spilling from well buckets (`quranic:root_001077:B003/m01`); a basin that retains water (`quranic:root_000018:B006/m01`); the first-built components of a trough (`quranic:root_001502:B007/m01`); a large jar (`quranic:root_001251:B003/m01`); abundant gathered water (`quranic:root_000532:B013/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene supplies distinct components rather than a loose water theme. Bucket, overflow, jar, trough masonry, basin, and stored abundance form a coherent capture-and-retention mechanism.

subchannels.name: Opening and directing a channel
subchannels.scene_or_process: A passage is opened and widened so retained water can be directed into a running channel.
subchannels.active_motifs: a river cutting the earth (`quranic:root_001559:B001/m01`); opening and widening until liquid flows (`quranic:root_001559:B003/m01`); swimming or flowing motion (`quranic:root_000666:B004/m01`); joining two ends (`quranic:root_001372:B010/m01`); a tree-lined watercourse in a valley (`quranic:root_001511:B007/m01`); gathered water (`quranic:root_000532:B013/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The channel is a continuous mechanism: openings are widened, endpoints joined, and water carried through a valley course. The daytime “swim” is thereby materialized as directed flow rather than motion without a bed.

subchannels.name: A loaded vessel under a captain
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cargo and rigging are carried over water while a captain directs the vessel beneath waves and sky.
subchannels.active_motifs: thick ship rope (`quranic:root_000260:B002/m01`); a captain of sailors (`quranic:root_000532:B017/m01`); wave crest or high back (`quranic:root_001077:B009/m01`); swimming through water (`quranic:root_000666:B004/m01`); freight and load (`quranic:root_000644:B001/m01`); upright mechanical part (`quranic:root_001273:B012/m01`); sky overhead (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Rope, freight, upright gear, wave, and captain complete a maritime role map. The lexical captain extends divine guardianship into skilled navigation of a loaded vessel.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Water becomes usable through a linked system of source, channel, lifting vessel, receiving basin, and controlled flow.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 73:5-9 anchors `نُلْقِى`, `نَاشِئَةَ`, `سَبْحًا`, `رَبِّكَ`, and `ٱلْمَغْرِبِ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The vocabulary assembles an almost complete hydraulic installation beneath passages usually read through worship, speech, and cosmic direction.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Proportion, Bodily Beauty, and Ethical Grace

subchannels.name: A well-proportioned body and face
subchannels.scene_or_process: Teeth, facial features, limbs, color, hair, and stature are arranged into a balanced visible form.
subchannels.active_motifs: even, well-spaced teeth (`quranic:root_000540:B003/m01`); balanced facial features (`quranic:root_001511:B009/m01`); distinct and complete limbs (`quranic:root_000082:B005/m01`); bodily stature (`quranic:root_001273:B011/m01`); strongly saturated color (`quranic:root_000790:B003/m01`); white eyelashes or hair (`quranic:root_001077:B012/m01`); tooth edges and moisture (`quranic:root_001077:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene is anatomically specific: spacing governs teeth, symmetry governs the face, separation defines limbs, and color and hair complete appearance. Ordered recitation thus resonates with an ordered visible body.

subchannels.name: Grace as proportionate conduct
subchannels.scene_or_process: Ethical action is held to a balanced measure, neither retaliatory excess nor degrading retreat.
subchannels.active_motifs: beauty in action (`quranic:root_000260:B004/m01`); fairness and equal dealing (`quranic:root_001511:B003/m01`); self-restraint (`quranic:root_000840:B001/m01`); straightness and moderation (`quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`); departure from a relation (`quranic:root_001578:B001/m01`); surpassing the ordinary limit in beauty (`quranic:root_001578:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The beautiful act is a proportioned response. Straightness and fairness prevent withdrawal from becoming either cowardice or aggression, while the lexical “surpassing beauty” intensifies the demanded quality of the departure.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Beauty arises when distinct parts are properly spaced, balanced, and coordinated into a gracious whole.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:3-4 and 73:10 anchor `نِّصْفَهُ`, `رَتِّلِ`, and `هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: “Beautiful abandonment” is reinforced by a concrete aesthetics of even teeth, balanced facial features, distinct limbs, color, and stature.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Generation, Gestation, and Maturation

subchannels.name: Coupling and conception
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sexual readiness leads to mounting, intercourse, and rapid conception.
subchannels.active_motifs: estrus of a she-camel (`quranic:root_001210:B009/m01`); a stallion mounting females (`quranic:root_000745:B003/m01`); intercourse (`quranic:root_001659:B006/m01`); rapid conception (`quranic:root_001372:B003/m01`); beginning of pregnancy (`quranic:root_001502:B009/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: These motifs form a sequential reproductive scene rather than a general fertility catalog. Readiness, mounting, union, conception, and the first material onset of pregnancy occupy distinct stages.

subchannels.name: Womb, pregnancy, and carried weight
subchannels.scene_or_process: A womb gathers and contains developing life until pregnancy becomes an embodied burden.
subchannels.active_motifs: a womb gathering fetus or blood (`quranic:root_001210:B004/m01`); gathered gestation in the womb (`quranic:root_001211:B003/m01`); pregnancy as heaviness (`quranic:root_000202:B007/m01`); load-bearing (`quranic:root_000644:B001/m01`); creation joined to nurture (`quranic:root_001502:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Gathering and carrying are the central operations. The weighty saying and the wrapped bearer are reframed through gestation: reception can be a prolonged containment in which a formed thing grows before emergence.

subchannels.name: Upbringing into mature strength
subchannels.scene_or_process: New life grows by sustained care until it reaches maturity, firmness, and a middle stage of life.
subchannels.active_motifs: youth growing within a people (`quranic:root_001502:B002/m01`); increase and growth (`quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`); nurture and completion by stages (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); a caretaker and raised child (`quranic:root_000532:B005/m01`); recent birth and youth (`quranic:root_000532:B009/m01`); reaching mature strength (`quranic:root_000782:B004/m01`); middle age (`quranic:root_001511:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Growth is not spontaneous enlargement but staged formation under care. The night’s rising and increase resonate with education and maturation, culminating in strength rather than mere size.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Formation proceeds through coupling, conception, containment, growth, care, and eventual strength.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 73:4-8 anchors `زِدْ`, `ٱلْقُرْءَانَ`, `ثَقِيلًا`, `نَاشِئَةَ`, `أَشَدُّ`, and `رَبِّكَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Night formation and weighty reception activate a complete biological sequence from mating through pregnancy to upbringing and mature strength.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Valuation and Provisioning

subchannels.name: Weighing, pricing, and bargaining
subchannels.scene_or_process: Goods are weighed and assigned value while buyer and seller negotiate increase or reduction.
subchannels.active_motifs: known weight (`quranic:root_000202:B004/m01`); a precious weighted object (`quranic:root_000202:B005/m01`); valuation and pricing (`quranic:root_001273:B010/m01`); equal-weight coin (`quranic:root_001273:B015/m01`); competitive bidding (`quranic:root_000657:B004/m01`); asking a lower price (`quranic:root_001542:B004/m01`); equitable dealing (`quranic:root_001511:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The same operations that adjust the night form a market scene: weigh, price, bid upward, bargain downward, and settle on an equitable amount. “Heavy” gains the additional sense of valued merchandise.

subchannels.name: Means, livelihood, and travel stores
subchannels.scene_or_process: A household or traveler secures the means that keep body and movement going.
subchannels.active_motifs: roaming for livelihood (`quranic:root_000666:B005/m01`); means, wealth, and capacity (`quranic:root_000959:B004/m01`); travel provisions (`quranic:root_000657:B005/m01`); support and subsistence (`quranic:root_001273:B009/m01`); scarcity and poverty (`quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`); need (`quranic:root_000532:B016/m01`); acquisition for oneself (`quranic:root_000018:B010/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Daytime breadth is materially a field of earning and movement. Capacity, acquired stores, and subsistence answer scarcity, while “need and blessing” keeps provision within a relation of dependence rather than autonomous wealth.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Resources are assessed, priced, apportioned, and stored so activity can be sustained without either scarcity or waste.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 73:3-7 anchors `نِّصْفَهُ`, `ٱنقُصْ`, `زِدْ`, `ثَقِيلًا`, `أَقْوَمُ`, and `سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Night measurement shades into market appraisal, while daytime movement becomes the livelihood that requires capital, provisions, and fair valuation.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Concentration, Preservation, and Stored Food

subchannels.name: Reducing and concentrating food
subchannels.scene_or_process: Liquids and fats are heated, dried, or combined until they become concentrated and durable.
subchannels.active_motifs: drink cooked down by half (`quranic:root_001511:B008/m01`); thick syrup or residue used to preserve and repair (`quranic:root_000532:B006/m01`); melted fat (`quranic:root_000260:B005/m01`); sun-dried meat (`quranic:root_000790:B002/m01`); a date-milk-ghee preparation (`quranic:root_001659:B007/m01`); wine or pressed date drink (`quranic:root_001077:B016/m01`); bitter medicinal aloe (`quranic:root_000840:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Half-reduction, thickening, melting, sun-drying, and mixing are distinct preservation operations in one kitchen process. The bitter aloe adds medicinal concentration, giving patient endurance a literal taste.

subchannels.name: Packing and serving durable stores
subchannels.scene_or_process: Concentrated provisions are packed into vessels or sacks and set out as a stored food supply.
subchannels.active_motifs: travel stores (`quranic:root_000657:B005/m01`); a large storage jar (`quranic:root_001251:B003/m01`); food heaped or laid on a table (`quranic:root_000840:B011/m01`); a food sack and prepared mixture (`quranic:root_001659:B007/m01`); thickened food and repaired skins (`quranic:root_000532:B006/m01`); taking the whole load (`quranic:root_000644:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Processing terminates in storage and service. Jar, sack, preserved skin, heap, and complete load make a compact provisioning scene suited to the traveler activated elsewhere in P1.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Perishable material is reduced, thickened, dried, melted, mixed, and stored to make concentrated sustenance.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 73:3-10 anchors `نِّصْفَهُ`, `ٱلْمَشْرِقِ`, `ٱلْمَغْرِبِ`, `ٱصْبِرْ`, and `جَمِيلًا`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Reducing the night by half resonates with reducing drink by half, while patience and horizon heat open onto preserved travel food.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Binding, Contest, and Release

subchannels.name: Fastening and immobilizing a body
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rope and fastening points bind an animal or person and restrict movement.
subchannels.active_motifs: tying and securing a bond (`quranic:root_000782:B001/m01`); a hobble joining limb to limb (`quranic:root_001578:B007/m01`); a long tether (`quranic:root_000959:B002/m01`); thick rope (`quranic:root_000260:B002/m01`); a gripping handle (`quranic:root_000018:B012/m01`); a stopper sealing an opening (`quranic:root_000840:B018/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene moves from rope to tether, hobble, handle, and stopper, each restricting a different degree of freedom. It supplies a concrete mechanics of restraint beneath the ethical command to restrain the self.

subchannels.name: Grappling, crushing, and feud
subchannels.scene_or_process: Opponents close distance, seize one another, press violently, and perpetuate retaliation.
subchannels.active_motifs: wrestling grip (`quranic:root_000018:B011/m01`); resistance and close contest (`quranic:root_001273:B014/m01`); a combat charge (`quranic:root_000782:B003/m01`); crushing seizure (`quranic:root_001659:B003/m01`); captive execution (`quranic:root_000840:B002/m01`); retaliatory killing (`quranic:root_000840:B012/m01`); blood feud (`quranic:root_000959:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Grip, resistance, charge, and pressure form one close-combat sequence, while execution and feud extend its outcome through time. P1’s beautiful withdrawal becomes a refusal to enter precisely this self-renewing mechanism.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Force organizes bodies by fastening them, bringing them into direct contest, or deliberately releasing them from engagement.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 73:5-10 anchors `ثَقِيلًا`, `أَشَدُّ وَطْـًٔا`, `فَٱتَّخِذْهُ`, `ٱصْبِرْ`, and `ٱهْجُرْهُمْ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The restrained response at 73:10 stands against a dense latent combat frame of hobbling, wrestling grips, crushing pressure, reprisal, and feud.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Acute Bodily Seizure and Sensory Failure

subchannels.name: Face, ear, and eye under impairment
subchannels.scene_or_process: An affliction takes the body and progressively compromises face, hearing, and sight.
subchannels.active_motifs: bodily illness taking hold (`quranic:root_000018:B007/m01`); facial palsy and distortion (`quranic:root_001372:B001/m01`); impaired hearing (`quranic:root_000202:B009/m01`); an intact-looking but blind eye (`quranic:root_001273:B021/m01`); running or swollen eye channels (`quranic:root_001077:B004/m01`); severe bodily disease (`quranic:root_001077:B017/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The symptoms occupy linked sensory sites: face alignment fails, hearing grows resistant, and the eye either runs or loses sight. “Taking” and “meeting” become invasive pathological actions rather than neutral contact.

subchannels.name: Tremor, pain, and burdened movement
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fear or anger produces shaking while pain and heaviness obstruct upright movement.
subchannels.active_motifs: a tremor from fear or anger (`quranic:root_001251:B005/m01`); pain fixed in an organ (`quranic:root_001273:B019/m01`); bodily heaviness and torpor (`quranic:root_000202:B006/m01`); severe pain or disease (`quranic:root_001077:B017/m01`); an ordeal with no exit (`quranic:root_000840:B006/m01`); harsh stony ground (`quranic:root_000840:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Tremor and localized pain destabilize the standing body, while torpor and rough ground obstruct recovery of gait. The resulting clinical scene gives bodily specificity to endurance under a severe burden.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Pressure becomes pathology when it takes hold of the body, distorts perception, and produces tremor, pain, or collapse.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 73:2-10 anchors `قَلِيلًا`, `ثَقِيلًا`, `أَشَدُّ`, `ٱلْمَغْرِبِ`, `فَٱتَّخِذْهُ`, and `ٱصْبِرْ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The bodily cost of “heaviness” is distributed across ear, eye, face, limbs, and involuntary movement.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Devotional Authority and Sustaining Care

subchannels.name: Worship through standing, reading, and remembrance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A devotee stands, reads, remembers, and declares transcendence in an ordered discipline.
subchannels.active_motifs: worship and the object of worship (`quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`); standing in prayer or remembrance (`quranic:root_001273:B002/m01`); devotional reading and study (`quranic:root_001210:B006/m01`); worship through praise and prayer (`quranic:root_000666:B001/m01`); declaring transcendence (`quranic:root_000666:B002/m01`); recollection (`quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`); naming aloud (`quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The practice joins posture, text, memory, and praise. Each operation has its own role, but together they form a disciplined devotional scene rather than a list of religious terms.

subchannels.name: Sovereign, teacher, caretaker, and guarantor
subchannels.scene_or_process: Authority sustains dependents by teaching, repairing, governing, and guaranteeing what has been entrusted.
subchannels.active_motifs: lordship and ownership (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); staged nurture and completion (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); learned divine instruction (`quranic:root_000532:B003/m01`); care and governance (`quranic:root_001273:B004/m01`); sufficient guardian and guarantor (`quranic:root_001681:B006/m01`); delegated responsibility (`quranic:root_001681:B001/m01`); covenant and protected relation (`quranic:root_000532:B011/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Authority is rendered as an ecology of care: knowledge guides, nurture develops, governance maintains, covenant binds, and surety protects. This widens the surface title “Lord” into the full set of functions needed to sustain the night discipline.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Worship is sustained by an authority who owns, teaches, nurtures, maintains, and protects the worshiper’s practice.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:2, 8-9 anchor `قُمِ`, `ٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ`, `رَّبُّ`, `إِلَٰهَ`, and `وَكِيلًا`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Divine rule is not only sovereignty; it includes pedagogy, repair, maintenance, surety, and the skilled direction of a vessel.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Deferred Appointment and Irreversible Arrival

subchannels.name: A short reprieve before an appointed time
subchannels.scene_or_process: A period of calm delay is granted, but it remains bounded by a specified appointment.
subchannels.active_motifs: deliberate delay and absence of haste (`quranic:root_001452:B001/m01`); a small interval (`quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`); postponement to a later time (`quranic:root_000019:B002/m01`); an appointment fixed by time or place (`quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`); a duration of time (`quranic:root_001700:B002/m01`); an event present in time (`quranic:root_001332:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Delay is not cancellation but a measured opening before an appointment. “Later” and temporal occurrence keep the reprieve inside a schedule whose endpoint remains intact.

subchannels.name: Promise becoming an accomplished event
subchannels.scene_or_process: A verbal commitment advances from expectation through arrival to enacted fact.
subchannels.active_motifs: a promise opening expectation (`quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`); threatening promise (`quranic:root_001662:B002/m01`); coming and arrival (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); calamity arriving upon a person (`quranic:root_000009:B011/m01`); return to an outcome or final meaning (`quranic:root_000067:B002/m01`); occurrence in time (`quranic:root_001332:B001/m01`); an enacted deed (`quranic:root_001167:B001/m01`); a calamitous day or event (`quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The sequence closes the distance between saying and reality. Arrival supplies the transition, occurrence supplies presence, action realizes it, and outcome names what the event finally becomes or means.

subchannels.name: Reading the celestial calendar
subchannels.scene_or_process: Moon position, halo, stellar mansion, and named days provide observable markers for scheduled time.
subchannels.active_motifs: the moon taking successive stations (`quranic:root_000018:B008/m01`); a lunar halo (`quranic:root_001613:B003/m01`); a lunar mansion of three stars (`quranic:root_001096:B006/m01`); a guiding mark or landmark (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`); the named day Tuesday (`quranic:root_000203:B006/m01`); daylight as a bounded unit (`quranic:root_001700:B001/m01`); an observable sign promising a future condition (`quranic:root_001662:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: These motifs form a practical timekeeping scene: celestial position is observed, marked, grouped, and translated into named units. The promised day is thus pressured by a latent calendar whose signs make an appointment legible.

subchannels.name: First, later, forward, and rear positions
subchannels.scene_or_process: A scheduled sequence distinguishes its beginning and predecessors from later, forward, and rearward positions.
subchannels.active_motifs: beginning or first position (`quranic:root_000067:B001/m01`); precedence in age, merit, or movement (`quranic:root_001452:B002/m01`); what comes after the first (`quranic:root_000019:B001/m01`); a rearward position (`quranic:root_000019:B003/m01`); forward advance or precedence (`quranic:root_001207:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Temporal order is made spatially legible. First and later establish sequence, precedence and advance establish relative movement, and the rear establishes the opposite position; deferred arrival therefore remains an ordered displacement, not an indefinite pause.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Delay belongs to a fixed schedule whose promised event ultimately arrives, occurs, and acquires the force of an accomplished act.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:11, 14, 17-18, and 20 anchor `مَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا`, `يَوْمَ`, `يَوْمًا`, `كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَفْعُولًا`, and `ءَاخَرُونَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Temporal reckoning extends into moon stations, lunar halos, star markers, weekday naming, and the contrast between first, later, and terminal positions.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Punitive Closure of Movement and Intake

subchannels.name: Binding, capture, and the neck grip
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body is seized, restrained by iron, and controlled at the neck or throat.
subchannels.active_motifs: a shackle that prevents movement (`quranic:root_001554:B001/m01`); arrest and capture (`quranic:root_000018:B003/m01`); wrestling hold (`quranic:root_000018:B011/m01`); taking hold around the neck (`quranic:root_000957:B009/m01`); gripping and crushing the throat (`quranic:root_000934:B012/m01`); direct striking (`quranic:root_000906:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Restraint proceeds from limb to neck: shackle prevents locomotion, capture removes agency, and the grappling hold concentrates control at the throat. The punitive scene is therefore mechanically continuous.

subchannels.name: Food that cannot be swallowed
subchannels.scene_or_process: A meal enters the mouth but lodges in the throat, turning nourishment into deprivation and pain.
subchannels.active_motifs: tasting and taking food (`quranic:root_000934:B001/m01`); obstruction in the throat (`quranic:root_001091:B001/m01`); abstention from food and drink (`quranic:root_000994:B002/m01`); prevention and weaning from a thing (`quranic:root_000994:B003/m01`); painful punishment (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`); unwholesome food that cannot be digested (`quranic:root_001619:B003/m01`); felt pain (`quranic:root_000046:B001/m01`); infliction of pain (`quranic:root_000046:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Taste initiates an expected nourishment sequence, but obstruction arrests it. Abstention becomes involuntary, the food proves unwholesome, and the failed passage culminates in inflicted and experienced pain.

subchannels.name: Enclosure by fire and molten heat
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fire, molten matter, and extreme heat surround the punished body.
subchannels.active_motifs: blazing infernal fire (`quranic:root_000225:B001/m01`); exposure to fire and its heat (`quranic:root_000879:B001/m01`); molten metal, oily dregs, or pus-like residue (`quranic:root_001452:B003/m01`); punishment by severe pain (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`); harmful heaviness (`quranic:root_001619:B002/m01`); clamor of fire and war (`quranic:root_001434:B001/m01`); marching in extreme heat (`quranic:root_001434:B002/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 73:11 `مَهِّلْهُمْ`; 73:12 `جَحِيمًا`; 73:13 `عَذَابًا`; 73:16 `وَبِيلًا`; 73:20 `صَّلَوٰةَ`; surface anchors unavailable for `quranic:root_001434:B001` and `quranic:root_001434:B002` because `م ع ع` is missing from root coverage
subchannels.synthesis: The scene combines radiant heat, direct burning, molten residue, and suffocating clamor. Even movement through the environment becomes a march inside heat, completing the closure of escape.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Punishment closes ordinary passages: limbs cannot move, the throat cannot pass food, and heat cannot be escaped.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:12-13 and 16-17 anchor `أَنكَالًا`, `جَحِيمًا`, `طَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ`, `عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا`, `أَخَذْنَٰهُ`, and `تَتَّقُونَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Fetters, a wrestling hold, a neck grip, an unwholesome meal, molten residue, and war-fire form one system of bodily closure rather than separate punishment images.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Failure of Earthly, Celestial, and Hydraulic Containment

subchannels.name: Mountain mass becoming poured sand
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hard elevated mass shakes, loses resistance, granulates, and pours away.
subchannels.active_motifs: violent shaking (`quranic:root_000545:B001/m01`); earth as the lower support (`quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`); a raised solid mountain mass (`quranic:root_000217:B001/m01`); hardness that stops excavation (`quranic:root_000217:B005/m01`); encounter with broad sand (`quranic:root_000217:B011/m01`); gathered dune material (`quranic:root_001285:B001/m01`); loose measure pouring without stability (`quranic:root_001613:B001/m01`); occurrence and transformation in time (`quranic:root_001332:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The process is a phase change in structural behavior: rigid mass begins to oscillate, breaks into aggregate, and flows like unmeasured grain. The branch sequence gives precise mechanics to the surface simile.

subchannels.name: The overhead cover splitting open
subchannels.scene_or_process: What normally rises above and covers the world tears and exposes the space beneath.
subchannels.active_motifs: sky or overhead canopy (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`); opening and splitting (`quranic:root_001165:B001/m01`); the lower realm opposite the sky (`quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`); a covering darkness or sea (`quranic:root_001307:B002/m01`); basic covering and concealment (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); an exposed body with no cover from the sky (`quranic:root_000994:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Sky and earth establish the vertical enclosure; splitting removes its upper boundary. The covering senses of `ك ف ر` sharpen the reversal: the same lexical field that hides now supplies the cover that can no longer remain closed.

subchannels.name: Water exceeding channels and boundaries
subchannels.scene_or_process: Heavy rain and imported runoff overwhelm the distinction between channel, land, and enclosing wall.
subchannels.active_motifs: an encircling flood (`quranic:root_000957:B002/m01`); heavy rain with large drops (`quranic:root_001619:B001/m01`); rain exceeding ordinary need (`quranic:root_000138:B006/m01`); runoff arriving from another land (`quranic:root_000009:B005/m01`); rain hanging between cloud and earth (`quranic:root_000672:B005/m01`); weather striking earth and vegetation (`quranic:root_000906:B013/m01`); a fortified enclosing wall (`quranic:root_000957:B010/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Rain descends, runoff arrives laterally, and flood circles the site until ordinary boundaries fail. The enclosing wall supplies the expected defense whose insufficiency makes the inundation a true collapse scene.

subchannels.name: Managed flow as the failed baseline
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water is ordinarily directed through a channel, gathered in a basin, retained at a source, and released into a river.
subchannels.active_motifs: a watercourse and the directing of its flow (`quranic:root_000009:B004/m01`); a basin that retains water (`quranic:root_000018:B006/m01`); abundant well or sea water (`quranic:root_001040:B005/m01`); gathered water (`quranic:root_000532:B013/m01`); a river (`quranic:root_001559:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Channel, basin, source, store, and river define a controlled hydraulic system. That ordinary sequence supplies the baseline against which excess runoff and rupture become failures of containment rather than undifferentiated water imagery.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Structures that normally support, cover, or channel material lose integrity and release what they hold.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:14 and 18 anchor `تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ`, `كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا`, and `ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Mountain collapse, sky rupture, flood, runoff, and hidden erosion are variants of one containment failure across solid, aerial, and liquid media.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Message Tested by Testimony and Enactment

subchannels.name: Envoy, carried message, and witness
subchannels.scene_or_process: An envoy arrives bearing a message, observes its recipients, and provides knowledgeable testimony.
subchannels.active_motifs: dispatch and release (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`); messenger and carried message (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); presence with direct observation (`quranic:root_000822:B001/m01`); testimony grounded in knowledge (`quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`); the tongue as a witness (`quranic:root_000822:B005/m01`); a sign that bears witness to time or condition (`quranic:root_000822:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Dispatch supplies the sender-recipient relation, the messenger carries the content, presence supplies observation, and testimony converts observation into accountable statement. Tongue and external marker extend witnessing from person to instrument and sign.

subchannels.name: Denial, rumor, and deceptive representation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Recipients reject the message while false representations circulate and generate disturbance.
subchannels.active_motifs: falsehood opposed to truth (`quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`); attributing falsehood to a speaker (`quranic:root_001290:B002/m01`); a deceptive dyed or patterned cloth (`quranic:root_001290:B009/m01`); denial and concealment of truth (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`); alarming or false rumor (`quranic:root_000545:B003/m01`); fabricated discourse made without a prior model (`quranic:root_001167:B004/m01`); disobedience to authority (`quranic:root_001022:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene distinguishes several failures of representation: direct lying, accusing another of lying, visual deception, fabricated composition, and rumor. Disobedience is the behavioral outcome when that representational refusal is directed at an envoy.

subchannels.name: Commitment verified by action
subchannels.scene_or_process: A promise is judged true when a corresponding act occurs and becomes observable fact.
subchannels.active_motifs: verbal commitment (`quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`); mutual commitment (`quranic:root_001662:B004/m01`); an enacted deed (`quranic:root_001167:B001/m01`); occurrence in time (`quranic:root_001332:B001/m01`); knowledgeable disclosure (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); finding an object as present (`quranic:root_001626:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Promise and action are not merged: promise establishes the claim, occurrence gives it temporal presence, knowledge recognizes it, and finding supplies experiential verification. The “fulfilled promise” is therefore a completed evidentiary chain.

subchannels.name: Answer, assent, and unstable alignment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A recipient answers affirmatively, then either embodies submission or merely aligns with whichever side prevails.
subchannels.active_motifs: saying yes in confirmation or promise (`quranic:root_001525:B004/m01`); answering a call (`quranic:root_001573:B003/m01`); bodily gesture of submission (`quranic:root_001307:B014/m01`); submissive yielding (`quranic:root_001332:B004/m01`); siding with the victor without a settled position (`quranic:root_001434:B005/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 73:11 `ٱلنَّعْمَةِ`; 73:14,18,20 `كَانَتِ/كَانَ/يَكُونُ`; 73:17 `كَفَرْتُمْ`; surface anchor unavailable for `quranic:root_001573:B003` because `ه ا ء` is missing from root coverage, and for `quranic:root_001434:B005` because `م ع ع` is missing from root coverage
subchannels.synthesis: Verbal yes, responsive answer, bodily deference, and inward yielding can align, but the opportunistic partisan exposes their possible separation. Recipient response is therefore tested not by assent alone but by whether word, posture, and durable position correspond.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A communicated claim is tested by witness, enacted fact, and the quality of its recipients’ response.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:11, 15-16, and 18-19 anchor `ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ`, `رَسُولًا شَٰهِدًا`, `عَصَىٰ ... ٱلرَّسُولَ`, `وَعْدُهُ مَفْعُولًا`, and `تَذْكِرَةٌ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Falsehood appears not only as lying but as a failed charge, deceptive cloth, rumor-induced panic, and fabricated composition.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Covering, Protection, and Exposure

subchannels.name: Protective barriers
subchannels.scene_or_process: A vulnerable object is placed behind a barrier, casing, wall, or film that intercepts harm.
subchannels.active_motifs: a barrier against damage (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`); placing oneself in protection (`quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`); a fortified enclosing wall (`quranic:root_000957:B010/m01`); fruit casing (`quranic:root_001307:B010/m01`); a woven film over the eye (`quranic:root_000672:B010/m01`); covering that preserves an object (`quranic:root_001096:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The barriers differ in scale but share one operation: interpose a layer between a vulnerable interior and damaging exterior. Piety is materialized as deliberately entering such a protective arrangement.

subchannels.name: Concealing truth and covering fault
subchannels.scene_or_process: Covering either suppresses a recognized truth or shields a wrongdoer from the consequence of fault.
subchannels.active_motifs: basic covering and concealment (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); denial that hides truth (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`); covering or denying a benefit (`quranic:root_001307:B004/m01`); covering sin and protecting its bearer from its effect (`quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`); removing an offense as though covered (`quranic:root_001307:B009/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The shared action of covering yields opposed moral relations. Denial uses a cover to suppress truth or benefit; forgiveness uses it to contain fault and prevent its destructive consequence.

subchannels.name: Roof, drape, and sky torn open
subchannels.scene_or_process: Overhead and hanging coverings are lowered or removed until the protected interior stands exposed.
subchannels.active_motifs: sky as overhead canopy (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`); splitting open (`quranic:root_001165:B001/m01`); roof terrace without a parapet (`quranic:root_000015:B003/m01`); exposure directly beneath the sky (`quranic:root_000994:B004/m01`); lowering a hanging cover (`quranic:root_000672:B004/m01`); draping a garment (`quranic:root_001163:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Canopy, parapet, and drape define protected edges; split, exposure, and lowering undo them. The ruptured sky becomes the largest instance of a familiar architectural failure.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A covering may preserve what is within, conceal what should be known, or fail and expose its contents.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:17-18 and 20 anchor `تَتَّقُونَ`, `كَفَرْتُمْ`, `ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌ`, and `غَفُورٌ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Protective barrier, fruit casing, eye film, garment, roof edge, forgiveness, disbelief, and sky cover all turn on the ethics and mechanics of concealment.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Compressed Life Cycle

subchannels.name: Womb, delivery, and afterbirth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Gestation approaches term, the child emerges, and bodily traces of delivery remain.
subchannels.active_motifs: womb as the vessel of offspring (`quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`); labor and placing down the child (`quranic:root_001683:B003/m01`); a newborn child (`quranic:root_001683:B004/m01`); afterbirth and womb discharge (`quranic:root_000994:B009/m01`); birth fluid or sign of maturity (`quranic:root_000822:B006/m01`); childbirth and postpartum blood (`quranic:root_001533:B005/m01`); nearing delivery (`quranic:root_000493:B004/m01`); postpartum uterine pain (`quranic:root_000552:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The motifs occupy successive roles in one birth scene: containing organ, approaching term, delivery, newborn, fluid trace, blood, and after-pain. This gives the surface’s children an extended biological origin rather than treating age as an isolated image.

subchannels.name: Childhood turning immediately to old age
subchannels.scene_or_process: A young dependent is transformed into a grey-haired figure without traversing ordinary duration.
subchannels.active_motifs: offspring and child (`quranic:root_001683:B001/m01`); a recently born child (`quranic:root_001683:B004/m01`); white hair and aging (`quranic:root_000833:B001/m01`); an old man defined by looking back on youth (`quranic:root_001332:B005/m01`); a calamitous day (`quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`); transforming a person into a new state (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The process is temporal compression expressed as transformation. Newborn status and retrospective old age are forced into direct adjacency by the calamitous day.

subchannels.name: Emergence, growth, and bodily markers
subchannels.scene_or_process: A newly created thing emerges, grows, and displays visible markers of development.
subchannels.active_motifs: generation of one thing from another (`quranic:root_001683:B005/m01`); creating and beginning (`quranic:root_001165:B002/m01`); tooth eruption (`quranic:root_001165:B007/m01`); growth and increase (`quranic:root_000637:B001/m01`); yield and production (`quranic:root_000009:B007/m01`); making or creating (`quranic:root_000248:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Creation is followed by derived existence, organic increase, productive yield, and the visible eruption of a tooth. The normal sequence provides the baseline that the sudden greying violently overrides.

subchannels.name: Lineage, household, and age cohort
subchannels.scene_or_process: A child enters a network of parents, kin, household dependents, caretakers, and age peers.
subchannels.active_motifs: parents (`quranic:root_001683:B002/m01`); kinship and family bond (`quranic:root_000552:B002/m01`); household or attached followers (`quranic:root_000067:B003/m01`); a caretaker and stepchild relation (`quranic:root_000532:B005/m01`); an age peer (`quranic:root_001683:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Birth does not produce an isolated body. It inserts the child into vertical descent, lateral kinship, domestic care, and a same-age cohort; the sudden greying therefore also disrupts the relational positions by which age is ordinarily recognized.

subchannels.name: Reproductive interval and recurrence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Menstruation alternates with purity, while the interval itself supplies a recurring unit for waiting and reproductive time.
subchannels.active_motifs: menstrual phase and its completion (`quranic:root_001210:B003/m01`); interval of purity and waiting between phases (`quranic:root_001210:B003/m02`); the appointed recurrence of menstruation and purity (`quranic:root_001211:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The branches distinguish bodily phase, intervening interval, and cyclic return. This recurrent reproductive clock supplies the ordinary temporal baseline from which gestation begins and against which the surah’s immediate child-to-grey transformation appears radically compressed.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Birth, growth, maturation, and aging can be accelerated until distant life stages collapse into one event.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:17 anchors `يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا`, with 73:13, 15, and 20 supplying `عَذَابًا`, `شَٰهِدًا`, `مَرْضَىٰ`, `زَّكَوٰةَ`, and `رَّحِيمٌ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The child-to-grey transformation is supported by a detailed reproductive ledger of womb, afterbirth, childbirth blood, near delivery, tooth eruption, and derived new life.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Volition, Compulsion, and Viable Capacity

subchannels.name: Will selecting a way
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person forms a will, takes a route as their own, and directs it toward a governing end.
subchannels.active_motifs: will directed toward a thing (`quranic:root_000831:B002/m01`); volition (`quranic:root_000832:B001/m01`); adopting something for oneself (`quranic:root_000018:B010/m01`); a traversable way (`quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`); lordship as governing endpoint (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); reminder restoring an option to awareness (`quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The reminder makes the option cognitively present, will selects it, taking establishes personal commitment, and the path converts decision into directed movement.

subchannels.name: Being carried, forced, or deterred
subchannels.scene_or_process: An external agent moves another toward an act or blocks movement through compulsion and exemplary restraint.
subchannels.active_motifs: carrying or compelling a person toward an affair (`quranic:root_000831:B003/m01`); forcing someone into an act (`quranic:root_000217:B010/m01`); coercing an obedient person into disobedience (`quranic:root_001307:B007/m01`); transforming someone’s state (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`); a shackle that prevents movement (`quranic:root_001554:B001/m01`); punishment that deters observers (`quranic:root_001554:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Compulsion and deterrence are distinct operations: one pushes a body toward an act, the other stops recurrence by displaying restraint and consequence. Together they define the non-voluntary alternatives against which chosen path-taking is read.

subchannels.name: Capacity adjusted to ease and suitability
subchannels.scene_or_process: A task is planned to fit available strength, health, and circumstances so it can be performed without collapse.
subchannels.active_motifs: effective ability and mastery (`quranic:root_001205:B003/m01`); a thing fitting its measure (`quranic:root_001205:B006/m01`); ease after difficulty (`quranic:root_001694:B001/m01`); what is suitable or readily possible (`quranic:root_000138:B002/m01`); an approach that prepares the affair (`quranic:root_000009:B003/m01`); weakened action and short movement (`quranic:root_001415:B004/m01`); suitability to one’s condition (`quranic:root_000637:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Capacity is relational, not absolute. Measure, suitability, preparation, and ease adapt the operation to impaired movement and changing circumstance, explaining how obligation can remain real while its quantity changes.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Action can arise from chosen direction, external coercion, or a capacity calibrated to what is actually possible.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:17, 19-20 anchor `تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ`, `فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ ... سَبِيلًا`, and `فَٱقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Choice is pressured by lexical scenes of forcing, deterrent restraint, suitability, preparation, illness, and eased passage.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Paths of Approach, Livelihood, and Combat

subchannels.name: Route, landmark, and directed approach
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler identifies a road by its markers, establishes direction, and approaches a destination.
subchannels.active_motifs: a road or means of access (`quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`); a guiding landmark (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`); a traveled thoroughfare and terminal line (`quranic:root_000009:B010/m01`); nearness and approach (`quranic:root_000493:B001/m01`); front or leading edge (`quranic:root_001207:B007/m01`); presence at the destination (`quranic:root_001052:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Road, landmark, forepart, nearness, and arrival assign concrete roles to path-taking. Direction is not merely moral orientation; it is a navigable approach whose progress can be observed.

subchannels.name: Commercial travel in search of surplus
subchannels.scene_or_process: Travelers cross the land to seek resources, conduct partnership trade, and return with gain.
subchannels.active_motifs: travel through the land for livelihood (`quranic:root_000906:B002/m01`); seeking a desired resource (`quranic:root_000138:B001/m01`); surplus remaining after need (`quranic:root_001163:B001/m01`); non-obligatory gift or benefit (`quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`); commercial partnership (`quranic:root_000906:B016/m01`); capital entrusted for trade (`quranic:root_001217:B004/m01`); wealth and means (`quranic:root_001626:B003/m01`); return from travel (`quranic:root_001207:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The route supports a full commercial process: search, travel, pooled capital, productive effort, surplus, and return. “Seeking bounty” is thereby grounded in a recognizable economy rather than generalized striving.

subchannels.name: Advancing along a battle route
subchannels.scene_or_process: A force scouts ahead, mobilizes, advances with courage, and engages an opposing side.
subchannels.active_motifs: reciprocal combat (`quranic:root_001200:B011/m01`); incitement toward battle (`quranic:root_000906:B017/m01`); advance scouts (`quranic:root_000138:B008/m01`); preparation for war (`quranic:root_000545:B004/m01`); courageous advance (`quranic:root_001207:B006/m01`); clamor of fighters and fire (`quranic:root_001434:B001/m01`); a traversable way (`quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 73:14 `تَرْجُفُ`; 73:19-20 `سَبِيلًا/يَضْرِبُونَ/يَبْتَغُونَ/يُقَٰتِلُونَ/سَبِيلِ`; surface anchor unavailable for `quranic:root_001434:B001` because `م ع ع` is missing from root coverage
subchannels.synthesis: Scouting precedes mobilization, incitement initiates forward motion, courage sustains it, and reciprocal combat supplies the terminal encounter. The path is the organizing corridor for the whole sequence.

subchannels.name: Lateral deviation and positional choice
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler can refuse the direct line, separate toward one side, pass laterally, or choose a forward or rearward position.
subchannels.active_motifs: refusal and deviation from a true course (`quranic:root_001052:B001/m01`); side-separation (`quranic:root_001052:B002/m01`); passing a place to one side (`quranic:root_001217:B002/m01`); taking the left side (`quranic:root_001694:B004/m01`); the rear or later position (`quranic:root_000019:B003/m01`); forward advance (`quranic:root_001207:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: A path includes crosswise decisions as well as forward progress. Deviation, separation, bypass, leftward movement, rear position, and advance map the alternatives by which an intended approach can be maintained or lost.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A way becomes meaningful through its destination and the kind of effort conducted along it.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:19-20 anchor `ٱتَّخَذَ ... سَبِيلًا`, `يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ`, and `يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same route system supports spiritual approach, commerce, scouting, return from travel, and military advance, with landmarks and lateral choices preventing “way” from remaining abstract.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Measured Contribution and Returned Value

subchannels.name: Portioning and counting the night
subchannels.scene_or_process: A duration is divided into exact fractions, estimated, counted, and adjusted to a manageable amount.
subchannels.active_motifs: the number three (`quranic:root_000203:B001/m01`); a third portion (`quranic:root_000203:B002/m01`); one half (`quranic:root_001511:B001/m01`); reaching a midpoint (`quranic:root_001511:B002/m01`); specified quantity and limit (`quranic:root_001205:B001/m01`); planning by calculation (`quranic:root_001205:B005/m01`); exhaustive counting (`quranic:root_000332:B002/m01`); equal weight or moderate quantity (`quranic:root_001273:B015/m01`); a small amount (`quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Number names identify the portions, midpoint locates them, measure sets their limit, and calculation attempts an exact ledger. Fewness and moderate weight allow the same system to reduce the burden when exhaustive counting fails.

subchannels.name: Loan, capital, and reciprocal return
subchannels.scene_or_process: Value is cut from one holder, transferred as capital or loan, and expected to return in equivalent or productive form.
subchannels.active_motifs: a loan or good deed whose return is sought (`quranic:root_001217:B003/m01`); capital entrusted for commerce (`quranic:root_001217:B004/m01`); reciprocal recompense (`quranic:root_001217:B005/m01`); commercial partnership (`quranic:root_000906:B016/m01`); giving or transferring (`quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`); wage or reward for work (`quranic:root_000015:B001/m01`); purification and due giving (`quranic:root_000637:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Loan and commercial capital share transfer but differ in contract; reciprocal recompense links both to eventual return. Purifying gift presses the scene beyond profit by making some transfers valuable precisely as relinquishment.

subchannels.name: Advancing a deed and finding it enlarged
subchannels.scene_or_process: A good act is sent ahead, later found present, and recognized as superior reward.
subchannels.active_motifs: prior merit and benefaction (`quranic:root_001207:B002/m01`); deliberately directing something forward (`quranic:root_001207:B010/m01`); finding what was sought (`quranic:root_001626:B001/m01`); beneficial good (`quranic:root_000452:B001/m01`); selected excellence (`quranic:root_000452:B002/m01`); magnitude and increased value (`quranic:root_001029:B001/m01`); reward for work (`quranic:root_000015:B001/m01`); beneficent action beyond bare justice (`quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The deed is treated as an advance placement rather than a vanished past act. Finding establishes persistence, goodness establishes quality, and magnitude describes the enlarged value of the returned result.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A contribution is first apportioned, then transferred, and finally recovered as value, benefit, or reward.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:20 anchors `ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُ وَثُلُثَهُ`, `يُقَدِّرُ`, `تُحْصُوهُ`, `أَقْرِضُوا ... قَرْضًا حَسَنًا`, `تُقَدِّمُوا`, `تَجِدُوهُ`, and `أَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Night fractions and devotional giving share the same operational grammar of amount, ledger, advance, loan, equivalent return, and multiplied value.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Illness, Accommodation, and Restorative Care

subchannels.name: Illness progressing under care
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body leaves equilibrium, movement weakens, a wound worsens or relapses, and an attendant works toward recovery.
subchannels.active_motifs: departure from bodily health (`quranic:root_001415:B001/m01`); tending a patient (`quranic:root_001415:B003/m01`); weakened action and curtailed movement (`quranic:root_001415:B004/m01`); dimness and loss of clarity (`quranic:root_001415:B005/m01`); illness taking the body (`quranic:root_000018:B007/m01`); relapse of illness or wound (`quranic:root_001096:B004/m01`); a suppurating sore (`quranic:root_000025:B011/m01`); a wound swelling toward corruption (`quranic:root_000138:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The clinical scene distinguishes disease, impaired function, local infection, relapse, and caregiving. Care is an active counter-process, not merely sympathy for an already named patient.

subchannels.name: Constriction opening into relief
subchannels.scene_or_process: A narrowed obligation is eased, the distressed person receives breathing room, and fault is covered through mercy.
subchannels.active_motifs: ease and readiness after difficulty (`quranic:root_001694:B001/m01`); material and practical breadth (`quranic:root_001694:B003/m01`); release from distress (`quranic:root_001533:B002/m01`); mercy and tender care (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`); forgiveness shielding from consequence (`quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`); inviting return and repentance (`quranic:root_000189:B003/m01`); constricting an amount (`quranic:root_001205:B004/m01`); fitting a thing to its measure (`quranic:root_001205:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Relief reverses constriction without dissolving measure. Breath, breadth, mercy, return, and forgiveness define distinct stages by which an unmanageable demand becomes a viable practice.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: When health or operative strength fails, care changes the task’s conditions and opens a path from constriction toward relief.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:20 anchors `عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ`, `تَيَسَّرَ`, `تَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ`, `ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا`, `غَفُورٌ`, and `رَّحِيمٌ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Accommodation is materialized through nursing, relapse, infected wounds, reduced movement, breathing room, and a measure fitted to the patient.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Ritual Ordering and Textual Access

subchannels.name: Text gathered, learned, and made accessible
subchannels.scene_or_process: Verbal material is collected into a readable whole, studied, remembered, and adjusted to what can be managed.
subchannels.active_motifs: gathering parts (`quranic:root_001210:B001/m01`); reading and recitation (`quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`); collected wording (`quranic:root_001211:B001/m01`); devotional study (`quranic:root_001210:B006/m01`); ease and readiness (`quranic:root_001694:B001/m01`); reminder restoring presence (`quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`); disclosed knowledge (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Collection makes a textual object, reading activates it, study develops competence, reminder restores it to attention, and ease adjusts access. The sequence explains how textual obligation survives changing capacity.

subchannels.name: Standing and maintaining prayer
subchannels.scene_or_process: A worshiper establishes a bodily and institutional practice that is maintained over time.
subchannels.active_motifs: bodily standing in prayer (`quranic:root_001273:B002/m01`); maintenance, care, and governance (`quranic:root_001273:B004/m01`); prescribed prayer (`quranic:root_000879:B003/m01`); prayer as blessing and mercy (`quranic:root_000879:B002/m01`); places of worship (`quranic:root_000879:B007/m01`); worship and the worshiped one (`quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Establishing prayer joins posture to maintenance: one stands, sets the practice upright, and keeps it in force. Blessing gives the practice an outward relational effect, while the worship place supplies its communal setting.

subchannels.name: Purifying transfer
subchannels.scene_or_process: Value leaves the giver as alms or loan and becomes purification, growth, and beneficent action.
subchannels.active_motifs: giving and transfer (`quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`); growth and increase (`quranic:root_000637:B001/m01`); purification and moral soundness (`quranic:root_000637:B002/m01`); a good loan whose return is sought (`quranic:root_001217:B003/m01`); beneficent action (`quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`); generous gift beyond obligation (`quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`); mercy toward another (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Transfer is productive without being reduced to profit. It cleans the giver, supports growth, benefits the recipient, and establishes a return relation whose quality is defined by goodness and mercy.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Devotion is made repeatable by joining accessible text, bodily maintenance, prayer, purification, and giving.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:19-20 anchor `تَذْكِرَةٌ`, `فَٱقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ`, `أَقِيمُوا ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ`, `ءَاتُوا ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ`, and `أَقْرِضُوا`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Reading is both collection and study; prayer is both formal worship and merciful blessing; almsgiving is simultaneously growth, purification, transfer, and productive advance.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Provision Ecology

subchannels.name: Rain-fed crop and yield
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rain reaches fertile ground, seed is covered, shoots form ears, fruit ripens, and yield is gathered.
subchannels.active_motifs: fertile productive land (`quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`); covering seed with earth (`quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`); an ear of grain (`quranic:root_000672:B008/m01`); organic growth (`quranic:root_000637:B001/m01`); crop and fruit yield (`quranic:root_000009:B007/m01`); fruit reaching maturity (`quranic:root_000934:B005/m01`); rain exceeding ordinary need (`quranic:root_000138:B006/m01`); a river channel through land (`quranic:root_001559:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Water, soil, seed cover, stalk, ripening, growth, and yield form a complete agricultural process. The same earth crossed by traders is also the productive substrate of the bounty they seek.

subchannels.name: Herd, milk, and animal nourishment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Livestock reproduce, fill the udder, release milk, gain fat, and ruminate.
subchannels.active_motifs: livestock wealth (`quranic:root_001525:B005/m01`); a she-camel filling three vessels or milking from three teats (`quranic:root_000203:B005/m01`); abundant milk and offspring (`quranic:root_001694:B006/m01`); continuous milk flow (`quranic:root_000563:B006/m01`); fat in animal flesh and marrow (`quranic:root_000934:B007/m01`); a camel chewing cud (`quranic:root_001217:B008/m01`); milk failing after appearing durable (`quranic:root_001290:B006/m01`); mating drive in sheep (`quranic:root_001619:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Reproduction initiates a dairy chain whose products are milk, fat, and sustained animal nourishment. The failed-milk motif marks the system’s vulnerability, contrasting real provision with an appearance that does not last.

subchannels.name: Food, livelihood, and generous distribution
subchannels.scene_or_process: Provision is acquired as livelihood, served to others, and redistributed as surplus or gift.
subchannels.active_motifs: feeding another and responding to need (`quranic:root_000934:B002/m01`); food as livelihood and good condition (`quranic:root_000934:B004/m01`); surplus after need (`quranic:root_001163:B001/m01`); generous gift (`quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`); generosity and donation (`quranic:root_000452:B005/m01`); wealth and practical means (`quranic:root_001626:B003/m01`); giving (`quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`); blessing and good condition (`quranic:root_001525:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Acquisition is only the first stage. Livelihood produces surplus, surplus enables feeding and gift, and giving circulates provision back through the social field.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Provision moves through land, rain, crop, livestock, processing, and social distribution.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:11, 13, and 20 anchor `أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ`, `طَعَامًا`, `فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ`, `يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ`, `ءَاتُوا ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ`, and `خَيْرٍ`.
