parent_channels.surprising_reach: The bundle assembles both a crop cycle and a dairy herd cycle beneath the surah’s contrast between luxury, punitive food, livelihood, and charitable giving.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Hearth and Meal Preparation

subchannels.name: Building and working the hearth
subchannels.scene_or_process: A pot is set on three supports, heated, handled with a cloth, and supplied with cut food.
subchannels.active_motifs: cooking pot and its contents (`quranic:root_001205:B007/m01`); the third hearthstone completing a support (`quranic:root_000203:B007/m01`); cloth used to lower or lift a hot pot (`quranic:root_000248:B007/m01`); cutting meat (`quranic:root_001638:B002/m01`); exposure to cooking fire (`quranic:root_000879:B001/m01`); blazing heat (`quranic:root_000225:B001/m01`); dough baked before proper maturation (`quranic:root_001165:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Each motif occupies a kitchen role: supports stabilize the vessel, fire heats it, cloth protects the handler, cutting portions the ingredient, and premature baking names failed timing. The scene supplies the ordinary productive counterpart to infernal heat.

subchannels.name: Reducing, sweetening, and serving drink
subchannels.scene_or_process: Natural sweets are gathered, a liquid is cooked down or blended to control strength, and the result is judged and consumed in measured sips.
subchannels.active_motifs: honey retained in its comb (`quranic:root_000822:B007/m01`); sweet gum gathered from trees (`quranic:root_001096:B007/m01`); drink reduced until one third remains (`quranic:root_000203:B008/m01`); diluting strong drink with water (`quranic:root_001200:B007/m01`); tasting and consuming (`quranic:root_000934:B001/m01`); sweetness and palatability (`quranic:root_000994:B001/m01`); a sip or breath of drinking (`quranic:root_001533:B006/m01`); oily dregs or molten residue (`quranic:root_001452:B003/m01`); cooking vessel (`quranic:root_001205:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Honey and tree gum supply sweetness, reduction concentrates, dilution softens, tasting judges, and the sip portions intake. The molten-dregs sense creates a dark bridge back to punitive heat, while palatable sweetness directly reverses the choking meal.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A meal is made by assembling a hearth, applying heat, cutting material, and controlling concentration.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 73:11-13 and 20 anchor `مَهِّلْهُمْ`, `جَحِيمًا`, `طَعَامًا`, `عَذَابًا`, `ثُلُثَهُ`, `أَنفُسِكُم`, and `يُقَٰتِلُونَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A pot, third hearthstone, lifting cloth, cut meat, fire, hastily baked dough, reduced drink, and measured sips form an ordinary kitchen whose operations are inverted by the punitive meal.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Prestige, Luxury, and Its Reversal

subchannels.name: Rank, comfort, and recognized excellence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A privileged person enjoys ease, occupies an advanced rank, and receives public recognition as excellent.
subchannels.active_motifs: blessing and good condition (`quranic:root_001525:B001/m01`); softness and luxurious living (`quranic:root_001525:B002/m01`); firstness and precedence in rank (`quranic:root_000067:B001/m01`); degree and distinction (`quranic:root_001163:B002/m01`); honor and social sanctity (`quranic:root_001029:B010/m01`); selected excellence (`quranic:root_000452:B002/m01`); beauty opposed to ugliness (`quranic:root_000323:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Comfort, priority, distinction, honor, selection, and beauty form a social rank scene. The surface targets are not simply wealthy; they are possessors of an entire apparatus that makes privilege visible and credible.

subchannels.name: Display, fame, and arrogant enlargement
subchannels.scene_or_process: Status is amplified through bodily display, crown, public fame, elite leadership, and explicit superiority claims.
subchannels.active_motifs: arrogance and self-enlargement (`quranic:root_001029:B006/m01`); padding used to enlarge bodily appearance (`quranic:root_001029:B008/m01`); crown as a covering of kingship (`quranic:root_001307:B015/m01`); good fame spreading (`quranic:root_000745:B008/m01`); public reputation (`quranic:root_000516:B007/m01`); leaders likened to mountains (`quranic:root_000217:B012/m01`); claiming superiority over peers (`quranic:root_001163:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Status is literally made larger, covered by a crown, broadcast as fame, and stabilized by mountain-like leaders. The scene exposes prestige as crafted display and social repetition, not intrinsic magnitude.

subchannels.name: Dispersal and abasement
subchannels.scene_or_process: A privileged collective loses cohesion, status, and secure abundance under a severe event.
subchannels.active_motifs: ostrich-like dispersal and loss of collective strength (`quranic:root_001525:B008/m01`); scarcity and abasement (`quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`); others replacing or following the first (`quranic:root_000019:B001/m01`); a calamitous event (`quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`); harmful consequence (`quranic:root_001619:B002/m01`); baseness and lowered rank (`quranic:root_000493:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Reversal acts socially as well as materially: the group scatters, the first gives way to others, abundance contracts, and rank falls. This process answers the apparent permanence of luxury.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Social distinction is constructed through comfort, rank, reputation, display, and claims of superiority, then exposed to reversal.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:11 anchors `ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ`, while 73:14-17 and 20 supply `ٱلْجِبَالُ`, `وَبِيلًا`, `شِيبًا`, `فَضْلِ`, `خَيْرًا`, and `أَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Crown, leaders-as-mountains, fame, padded bodily display, dispersal, abasement, and scarcity make luxury a fragile social construction rather than a stable possession.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Governance, Levy, and Deterrent Liability

subchannels.name: Household rule and sustaining authority
subchannels.scene_or_process: A ruler or household head gathers dependents, governs their affairs, and assumes responsibility for their maintenance.
subchannels.active_motifs: household and followers returning to a head (`quranic:root_000067:B003/m01`); governance and administrative repair (`quranic:root_000067:B004/m01`); ownership and sovereignty (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); nurture and completion (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); care and rule (`quranic:root_001273:B004/m01`); surety for another (`quranic:root_001332:B003/m01`); possessor or holder of a quality (`quranic:root_000527:B001/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 73:11 `أُو۟لِى`; 73:14,18,20 `كَانَتِ/كَانَ/يَكُونُ`; 73:19-20 `رَبِّهِ/رَبَّكَ`; surface anchor unavailable for `quranic:root_000527:B001` because `ذ و و` is missing from root coverage
subchannels.synthesis: Rule is rooted in a returning household relation, then specified as care, repair, maintenance, and surety. The possessor construction adds the status by which authority and privilege are socially attributed.

subchannels.name: Tribute, tax, covenant, and wage
subchannels.scene_or_process: A polity fixes obligations through covenant and collects assessed value as tribute, tax, loan, or compensated labor.
subchannels.active_motifs: tribute or levy paid by a population (`quranic:root_000009:B008/m01`); tax imposed on person or land (`quranic:root_000906:B010/m01`); a loan or deed awaiting return (`quranic:root_001217:B003/m01`); wage and contractual hire (`quranic:root_000015:B001/m01`); covenant and protected agreement (`quranic:root_000532:B011/m01`); mutual promising (`quranic:root_001662:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: These transfers differ legally but share institutional assessment. Covenant creates the relation, tribute and tax impose payment, loan anticipates return, and wage compensates service.

subchannels.name: Testimony establishing sanction
subchannels.scene_or_process: A violation is established by witness, attributed to its actor, and answered with a deterrent consequence.
subchannels.active_motifs: knowledgeable testimony (`quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`); attribution of falsehood (`quranic:root_001290:B002/m01`); accountability for an offense (`quranic:root_000018:B002/m01`); deterrent punishment (`quranic:root_001554:B003/m01`); painful sanction (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`); harmful consequence (`quranic:root_001619:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Witness establishes the event, attribution identifies the violation, accountability attaches it to the actor, and sanction converts judgment into deterrence. The sequence makes punishment an institutional act rather than raw force.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Rule maintains a household or polity through care, contracts, assessed transfers, testimony, and sanctions that establish responsibility.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:11, 15-16, and 20 anchor `أُو۟لِى`, `رَسُولًا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ`, `أَخَذْنَٰهُ`, `ءَاتُوا`, `أَقْرِضُوا`, and `أَجْرًا`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The Pharaoh precedent activates not only kingship but a full administrative frame of household allegiance, tribute, tax, covenant, wage, surety, and exemplary punishment.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Mobilization, Capture, and Mortal Outcome

subchannels.name: Mobilization and engagement
subchannels.scene_or_process: A force prepares, is incited, advances with courage, and meets an opposing force in reciprocal combat.
subchannels.active_motifs: preparation for war (`quranic:root_000545:B004/m01`); war at its fiercest (`quranic:root_000225:B002/m01`); incitement to fight (`quranic:root_000906:B017/m01`); reciprocal combat (`quranic:root_001200:B011/m01`); courageous forward movement (`quranic:root_001207:B006/m01`); clamor of warriors (`quranic:root_001434:B001/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 73:12 `جَحِيمًا`; 73:14 `تَرْجُفُ`; 73:20 `يَضْرِبُونَ/يُقَٰتِلُونَ/تُقَدِّمُوا`; surface anchor unavailable for `quranic:root_001434:B001` because `م ع ع` is missing from root coverage
subchannels.synthesis: Preparation and incitement precede advance; advance culminates in a two-sided encounter. Fire and clamor make mobilization audible and environmental, not only strategic.

subchannels.name: Capture and exposure to death
subchannels.scene_or_process: Close engagement produces a grip, capture, bodily vulnerability, and possible extinction.
subchannels.active_motifs: arrest and captivity (`quranic:root_000018:B003/m01`); wrestling seizure (`quranic:root_000018:B011/m01`); throat grip in combat (`quranic:root_000934:B012/m01`); making someone vulnerable to killing (`quranic:root_001200:B005/m01`); extinction of a person or people (`quranic:root_001217:B009/m01`); life and soul lost at death (`quranic:root_001533:B011/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Grip becomes capture, capture creates vulnerability, and vulnerability opens onto death at both individual and collective scale. The soul motif specifies what is removed when the sequence reaches its mortal outcome.

subchannels.name: Subjugation and the heavy instrument
subchannels.scene_or_process: Defeated resistance is broken by force and trained into compliance.
subchannels.active_motifs: killing and removal of life (`quranic:root_001200:B001/m01`); subjugating and taming until hardness softens (`quranic:root_001200:B002/m01`); deterrent punishment (`quranic:root_001554:B003/m01`); a heavy club or beating beam (`quranic:root_001619:B004/m01`); direct striking (`quranic:root_000906:B001/m01`); transforming a person’s state (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The outcome is not only death: force can also break resistance into trained compliance. Club, strike, transformation, and deterrence define a coercive post-capture process distinct from battlefield movement.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Organized conflict moves from preparation and advance to close engagement, capture, subjugation, and death.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:15-16 and 20 anchor `رَسُولًا`, `أَخَذْنَٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا`, and `يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The battle field includes rumor-driven mobilization, war clamor, throat holds, taming, clubs, exposure to killing, and the extinction of a group.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Animal Drive in Racing and Breeding

subchannels.name: Gait, racing order, and the sore hoof
subchannels.scene_or_process: A horse is urged into smooth movement, exposes its withers, advances in race order, and may shorten stride to protect a sore hoof.
subchannels.active_motifs: smooth easy gait (`quranic:root_000563:B003/m01`); successive detachments (`quranic:root_000563:B005/m01`); the horse’s muzzle and requested run (`quranic:root_000934:B009/m01`); elevated withers beneath the rider’s hand (`quranic:root_001285:B003/m01`); a prancing horse (`quranic:root_000138:B007/m01`); a camel advancing by its foreleg gait (`quranic:root_000009:B009/m01`); courageous advance (`quranic:root_001207:B006/m01`); light responsive movement (`quranic:root_001694:B005/m01`); protecting a painful hoof (`quranic:root_001677:B003/m01`); the second horse following the winner (`quranic:root_000879:B006/m01`); an animal running and then stopping (`quranic:root_001290:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene specifies body part, handling point, gait, order, motivation, and injury response. Ease becomes a quality of movement, while stopping can signal either failure or protective adaptation.

subchannels.name: Stallion signal, estrus, mating, and milk
subchannels.scene_or_process: A male signals readiness, females enter estrus, mating occurs, and reproduction yields milk.
subchannels.active_motifs: stallion’s threatening roar before mounting (`quranic:root_001662:B005/m01`); female animal seeking a male (`quranic:root_000248:B009/m01`); mating of a male camel with a female (`quranic:root_000906:B011/m01`); estrus of a she-camel (`quranic:root_000009:B012/m01`); mating drive in sheep (`quranic:root_001619:B006/m01`); milk and offspring increasing (`quranic:root_001694:B006/m01`); milk flowing continuously (`quranic:root_000563:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Signal, estrus, mating, conception potential, and lactation form a reproductive sequence. Forward drive is redirected from race progress into generative productivity.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Animal force is expressed as directed forward drive, whether toward a finish, a mate, or productive offspring.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 73:15-16 and 20 anchor `أَرْسَلْنَا`, `وَبِيلًا`, `يَضْرِبُونَ`, `يَبْتَغُونَ`, `تُقَدِّمُوا`, and `تَيَسَّرَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Messenger-sending, precedence, ease, deterrence, and productive increase are all pressured by a detailed equine and herd mechanics.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Cutting, Shaping, and Material Finish

subchannels.name: The shaping workshop
subchannels.scene_or_process: Workers cut and strike material, hew wood, grind solids, and weave a stable form.
subchannels.active_motifs: cutting with shears or teeth (`quranic:root_001217:B001/m01`); adze for shaping wood (`quranic:root_001207:B008/m01`); grinding stone (`quranic:root_000879:B008/m01`); workers including carpenter and digger (`quranic:root_001167:B003/m01`); heavy mallet or beating beam (`quranic:root_001619:B004/m01`); well-made weaving (`quranic:root_000217:B007/m01`); tools, striking place, and tent-making (`quranic:root_000906:B014/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Cutting establishes edges, adze and mallet shape mass, grinding reduces particles, and weaving assembles strands. Worker and tool roles make this a single production floor rather than a tool list.

subchannels.name: Textile covering and surface treatment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A woven surface receives nap, coating, dye, drape, or tanning treatment that changes appearance and durability.
subchannels.active_motifs: basic covering (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); raised nap or hair on cloth (`quranic:root_001096:B003/m01`); draped garment (`quranic:root_001163:B005/m01`); a small tanning dose (`quranic:root_001533:B007/m01`); dyed cloth whose appearance deceives (`quranic:root_001290:B009/m01`); well-made weaving (`quranic:root_000217:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Weaving creates the substrate, nap and tanning alter its physical surface, dye changes its visual claim, and draping puts the finish into use. The deceptive cloth provides a concrete analogy for covering that misrepresents what lies beneath.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Raw material becomes a finished object through cutting, striking, grinding, weaving, covering, and surface treatment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 73:14, 17-18, and 20 anchor `ٱلْجِبَالُ`, `كَفَرْتُمْ`, `مَفْعُولًا`, `يَضْرِبُونَ`, `قَرْضًا`, and `تُقَدِّمُوا`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The language of action and fulfilled promise activates an artisan workshop containing shears, adze, mallet, grinding stone, textile, pile, coating, and tanning dose.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Collective Assembly, Partition, and Dispersal

subchannels.name: Gathering into a whole
subchannels.scene_or_process: Individuals gather into a crowd or party whose members are treated as one operational whole.
subchannels.active_motifs: a party or group of people (`quranic:root_000957:B004/m01`); gathering parts into one (`quranic:root_001210:B001/m01`); a multitude likened to a mountain (`quranic:root_000217:B002/m01`); large gathered groups (`quranic:root_000532:B004/m01`); a people or social body (`quranic:root_001273:B001/m01`); the whole crowd without exception (`quranic:root_001096:B008/m01`); a place filled tightly by people (`quranic:root_001091:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Gathering scales from party to people to mountain-like multitude, while crowding names the spatial consequence of density. “The whole crowd” closes the scene by removing residual outsiders.

subchannels.name: Portioning and scattering the collective
subchannels.scene_or_process: A whole is divided into a party and “others,” sent in successive units, directed to a side, or dispersed in defeat.
subchannels.active_motifs: a piece or portion of a larger thing (`quranic:root_000957:B004/m02`); another group after or apart from the first (`quranic:root_000019:B001/m01`); passing a place to one side (`quranic:root_001217:B002/m01`); taking the left side (`quranic:root_001694:B004/m01`); successive groups sent one after another (`quranic:root_000563:B005/m01`); collective dispersal and loss of strength (`quranic:root_001525:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Division can be organized or catastrophic. Party, side, and succession produce functional units; dispersal breaks the relation that made the collective effective.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A collective can gather as a whole, divide into functional portions, move in successive groups, or lose cohesion.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:11, 14-15, and 20 anchor `ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ`, `ٱلْجِبَالُ`, `إِلَيْكُمْ`, `طَآئِفَةٌ`, and repeated `ءَاخَرُونَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Crowd, herd, party, gathered whole, successive detachment, leftward branch, and ostrich-like scattering provide a precise social morphology.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Inward Self, Desire, and Breath

subchannels.name: Inward purpose and affect
subchannels.scene_or_process: The self forms an intention, is drawn toward a valued object, and experiences love, grief, anger, or rivalry.
subchannels.active_motifs: inward purpose and discernment (`quranic:root_001533:B013/m01`); attraction of the self toward a thing (`quranic:root_000831:B005/m01`); love or grief felt inwardly (`quranic:root_001626:B004/m01`); anger and resentment (`quranic:root_001626:B005/m01`); precious value provoking competition (`quranic:root_001533:B010/m01`); the self characterized as deceptive (`quranic:root_001290:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Intention supplies direction, attraction supplies motive, and affect registers the result. Competition and self-deception show how perceived value can distort that inward process.

subchannels.name: Breath, life, and relief
subchannels.scene_or_process: A living body breathes, enters constriction, and receives enough opening to continue.
subchannels.active_motifs: breath leaving the body (`quranic:root_001533:B001/m01`); relief from distress (`quranic:root_001533:B002/m01`); blood as bodily life-support (`quranic:root_001533:B004/m01`); living soul (`quranic:root_001533:B011/m01`); bodily self and identity (`quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`); ease after difficulty (`quranic:root_001694:B001/m01`); mercy and tenderness (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Breath, blood, soul, and bodily identity describe what must be preserved; relief and ease describe the opening that preserves it. Mercy thus enters as a life-sustaining operation, not an abstract sentiment.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The self mediates intention, attraction, emotion, bodily life, and the need for relief.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:19-20 anchor `شَآءَ`, `لِأَنفُسِكُم`, `تَجِدُوهُ`, `ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا`, and `رَّحِيمٌ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: “Self” extends from inward purpose to breath, blood, living soul, precious competition, grief, love, anger, and release from constriction.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Making, Existing, and Transforming

subchannels.name: Creating and bringing into existence
subchannels.scene_or_process: An agent originates a thing, which then occurs and stands as an existing object that can be known or found.
subchannels.active_motifs: making or creating (`quranic:root_000248:B001/m01`); originating and beginning creation (`quranic:root_001165:B002/m01`); occurrence in time (`quranic:root_001332:B001/m01`); location and standing in existence (`quranic:root_001332:B002/m01`); existence after absence (`quranic:root_001626:B002/m01`); a knowable and reportable thing (`quranic:root_000831:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Creation names agency, occurrence supplies time, place supplies position, and existence makes the result available to knowledge and report. The stages prevent “making” from becoming an undifferentiated synonym for being.

subchannels.name: Beginning, fabricating, and changing state
subchannels.scene_or_process: An agent starts an operation, may construct a false artifact, or transforms an existing object into a new condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: beginning and persisting in an act (`quranic:root_000248:B004/m01`); enacted work (`quranic:root_001167:B001/m01`); fabricated composition (`quranic:root_001167:B004/m01`); transforming a thing’s condition (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`); derived novelty produced from another thing (`quranic:root_001683:B005/m01`); acting hurriedly (`quranic:root_001434:B004/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 73:17 `يَجْعَلُ/ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ/شِيبًا`; 73:18 `مَفْعُولًا`; 73:20 `يَكُونُ`; surface anchor unavailable for `quranic:root_001434:B004` because `م ع ع` is missing from root coverage
subchannels.synthesis: Beginning establishes process, work realizes it, and transformation changes an existing patient; fabrication is a rival operation that produces an artifact without truthful correspondence. Hurried work names a failure mode in which process outruns proper formation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A thing moves from possibility through creation and occurrence into a changed, identifiable state.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:14, 17-18, and 20 anchor `كَانَتِ`, `يَجْعَلُ`, `كَانَ`, `مَفْعُولًا`, `يَكُونُ`, and `تَجِدُوهُ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Creation, existence, fabrication, and transformation are kept distinct, allowing the fulfilled promise and altered children or mountains to be read as different ontological operations.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Capture by Device and Division by Lot

subchannels.name: Hunter, lure, snare, and quarry
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hunter draws an animal into range and captures it with a snare or trained hunting instrument.
subchannels.active_motifs: hunters going out after game (`quranic:root_000745:B006/m01`); a bow or hunting implement that feeds its owner (`quranic:root_000934:B006/m01`); a snare set for capture (`quranic:root_000879:B004/m01`); luring an animal from its den (`quranic:root_000452:B006/m01`); protective barrier around vulnerable prey (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`); a named raptor used in the hunting field (`quranic:root_001040:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Hunter, lure, implement, snare, prey-defense, and raptor fill the roles of one capture scene. Provision here is obtained by controlling approach and escape.

subchannels.name: Gaming arrows and apportioned carcass
subchannels.scene_or_process: Participants cast marked lots, use a quiver or container, divide a slaughtered animal, and assign shares.
subchannels.active_motifs: gaming arrows and division of a slaughtered camel (`quranic:root_001694:B007/m01`); the fifth gaming arrow (`quranic:root_001533:B016/m01`); a container gathering arrows (`quranic:root_000532:B010/m01`); cutting a share from a whole (`quranic:root_001217:B001/m01`); the number three as an apportioned count (`quranic:root_000203:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Marked implements randomize assignment, the container organizes them, cutting creates portions, and number identifies quantity. This is a distributive mechanism distinct from commercial valuation or charitable transfer.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A desired resource is acquired through an apparatus that constrains movement or assigns shares.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 73:13, 17, and 20 anchor `طَعَامًا`, `تَتَّقُونَ`, `يَبْتَغُونَ`, `قَرْضًا`, and `أَنفُسِكُم`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Hunting snare, raptor, lure, gaming arrows, quiver, carcass division, and musk-piece lot form two concrete acquisition systems.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Relinquishment and Transferred Handling

subchannels.name: Leaving an affair to accountable custody
subchannels.scene_or_process: One actor releases an affair while another assumes ownership, accountability, and surety for its handling.
subchannels.active_motifs: leaving a thing (`quranic:root_001638:B003/m01`); holding a person accountable for fault (`quranic:root_000018:B002/m01`); ownership and sovereignty (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); surety and undertaking another’s care (`quranic:root_001332:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Relinquishment does not erase the affair; it moves it under a different holder. Accountability specifies judgment, sovereignty specifies authority, and surety specifies continued care, turning “leave me” into a transfer of operative control.

subchannels.name: Recoil, restraint, disavowal, and submission
subchannels.scene_or_process: A participant withdraws from action through weakness or deliberate restraint, disowns a relation, or yields under pressure.
subchannels.active_motifs: recoiling from an affair through fear or weakness (`quranic:root_001554:B002/m01`); holding back and turning away (`quranic:root_000906:B004/m01`); abstaining or preventing another (`quranic:root_000994:B003/m01`); disavowal and severance from a thing (`quranic:root_001307:B005/m01`); submissive yielding (`quranic:root_001332:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The branches distinguish inability, chosen restraint, imposed prevention, relational disavowal, and final submission. They pressure the surface movement from reprieve to seizure by showing several non-equivalent ways agency can be withdrawn.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Releasing an affair changes who holds, answers for, restrains, or submits it.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:11-12, 16-20 anchor `وَذَرْنِى`, `مَهِّلْهُمْ`, `أَنكَالًا`, `أَخَذْنَٰهُ`, `كَفَرْتُمْ`, `ٱتَّخَذَ`, and `تَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Leaving is not a single empty gesture: it can transfer accountability to a sovereign guarantor, recoil in weakness, impose restraint, disavow an attachment, or end in submission.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Bodily Signs of Crisis

subchannels.name: Convulsion and heated anger
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fear or anger produces tremor, involuntary motion, pulse, and heat visible at the face.
subchannels.active_motifs: a bodily tremor or shaking (`quranic:root_000025:B008/m01`); possessed involuntary head and body movement (`quranic:root_000025:B012/m01`); disturbed pulsing or agitation (`quranic:root_000906:B012/m01`); trembling from fear or anger (`quranic:root_001251:B005/m01`); felt anger (`quranic:root_001626:B005/m01`); a face blazing with anger (`quranic:root_000225:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Tremor supplies the gross motion, pulse the internal rhythm, and anger the affective heat that reaches the face. The earth’s convulsion and the fire’s blaze are thereby materialized as a body losing voluntary stillness.

subchannels.name: Face, eye, lip, and hair as diagnostic surface
subchannels.scene_or_process: Crisis marks the body through an inflamed or jutting eye, obscured vision, a cleft lip, facial distortion, and prematurely white hair.
subchannels.active_motifs: an inflamed or jutting eye (`quranic:root_000225:B003/m01`); an eye-film like woven threads (`quranic:root_000672:B010/m01`); a visible cleft in the upper lip (`quranic:root_001040:B004/m01`); a disfigured face or form (`quranic:root_000832:B002/m01`); white hair and aging (`quranic:root_000833:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: These motifs treat the visible body as evidence: eye posture registers intensity, the film registers impaired perception, lip and face register altered form, and white hair registers compressed age. The child-to-grey image becomes one member of a wider diagnostic surface.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Acute crisis becomes legible through involuntary motion and visible changes in face, eye, lip, and hair.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 73:12, 14, 17, and 20 anchor `جَحِيمًا`, `تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ`, `شِيبًا`, `مَرْضَىٰ`, and `تَجِدُوهُ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Cosmic shaking and infernal heat are reframed as somatic diagnostics: convulsion, pulse, fear-tremor, anger-flush, jutting eye, eye-film, cleft lip, facial distortion, and greying.

parent_channels.name: S1. P1 - Verse Modeling and Repeated Rhyme
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A composition follows an earlier poetic model and binds successive lines through repeated rhyme.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a poetic method, model, or intended course (`quranic:root_001210:B011/m01`); a poem following another poem’s pattern (`quranic:root_001211:B005/m01`); repeated identical rhyme (`quranic:root_001659:B005/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Model supplies the compositional path and rhyme supplies recurrence at its line endings. The scene usefully pressures ordered recitation by distinguishing patterned verbal making from the assembly and delivery of speech.

parent_channels.name: S2. P1 - Treated Garment and Veil
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Hide or cloth is strengthened with a thick treatment, made into a garment or veil, and wrapped around a wearer.
parent_channels.active_motifs: wrapping oneself in clothes (`quranic:root_000644:B003/m01`); a veil or covering garment (`quranic:root_001511:B006/m01`); a strong leather garment (`quranic:root_000666:B007/m01`); thick extract used to treat hide, vessels, medicine, or food (`quranic:root_000532:B006/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Treatment, material, garment form, and wrapping occupy successive roles in one clothing scene. It gives the opening epithet a material underside without merging the wearer’s covering with the distinct operation of burden-bearing.

parent_channels.name: S3. P2 - Deictic Presentation and Response
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A speaker calls attention, presents an object for taking, asks about it, and receives a verbal response.
parent_channels.active_motifs: presenting something with “take” (`quranic:root_001573:B001/m01`); attention-opening particle (`quranic:root_001573:B002/m01`); response and answering a call (`quranic:root_001573:B003/m01`); interrogative particle (`quranic:root_001573:B004/m01`); demonstrative reference (`quranic:root_000527:B003/m01`); interrogative or relative “what” (`quranic:root_000527:B004/m01`); a knowable object of reference (`quranic:root_000831:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 73:19 `شَآءَ`; surface anchors unavailable for the `quranic:root_001573:*` motifs because `ه ا ء` is missing from root coverage, and for the `quranic:root_000527:*` motifs because `ذ و و` is missing from root coverage
parent_channels.synthesis: The motifs form a compact exchange: attention is opened, an object is indicated and offered, a question isolates it, and a response acknowledges the call. It remains standalone because its discourse-participant structure is not the same as messenger testimony or inward volition.

parent_channels.name: S4. P2 - Ostrich Family and Flock Dispersal
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Adult ostriches, their chicks, and ostrich-like forms gather and then scatter under pressure.
parent_channels.active_motifs: adult ostrich (`quranic:root_001525:B006/m01`); objects and body-parts likened to an ostrich (`quranic:root_001525:B007/m01`); flock dispersal and loss of strength (`quranic:root_001525:B008/m01`); ostrich chick (`quranic:root_000248:B010/m01`); a newly generated being (`quranic:root_001683:B005/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Adult, chick, and flock behavior form a complete animal scene, while analogical body forms explain how the bird’s shape enters other objects. Its characteristic scattering usefully pressures the affluent collective of 73:11 without merging with the broader social-partition channel.

parent_channels.name: S5. P2 - Formal Text Modeling and Composition
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A verbal work selects a prior model, composes measured lines, and makes a representation that can be faithful or fabricated.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a poetic method, model, or intended course (`quranic:root_001210:B011/m01`); a poem following another poem’s pattern (`quranic:root_001211:B005/m01`); composing poetry (`quranic:root_001217:B007/m01`); making a representation or illustrative example (`quranic:root_000906:B003/m01`); a form, type, or model for replication (`quranic:root_000906:B007/m01`); fabricated composition without a prior truthful model (`quranic:root_001167:B004/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Pattern, poetic making, representation, and type describe formal construction; fabrication identifies its truth-failing counterpart. This remains separate from textual access because it concerns how a verbal object is modeled and made, not how much of it can be read.

parent_channels.name: S6. Whole Surah - Night Patrol and Road Guardianship
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A watchman repeatedly circles at night, guarding a route used by travelers.
parent_channels.active_motifs: circling around a place (`quranic:root_000957:B001/m01`); a night watchman making protective rounds (`quranic:root_000957:B005/m01`); nighttime movement (`quranic:root_001392:B002/m01`); road users and travelers (`quranic:root_000672:B002/m01`); a sufficient guardian and guarantor (`quranic:root_001681:B006/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Route, traveler, darkness, repeated circuit, and guardian form a complete patrol scene. It materializes night standing as wakeful vigilance and usefully reframes `وَكِيلًا` as active protection exercised through repeated rounds rather than static custody.

parent_channels.name: S7. Whole Surah - Lashed Raft and River Crossing
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Inflated skins or timbers are bound into a floating carrier, loaded, and used to continue a route across a river.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a thick ship rope or hawser (`quranic:root_000260:B002/m01`); a raft of inflated skins or lashed wood (`quranic:root_000957:B006/m01`); lifting and carrying a load (`quranic:root_001251:B004/m01`); a river channel (`quranic:root_001559:B001/m01`); a road or means of passage (`quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Rope supplies cohesion, the raft supplies buoyancy, and the river supplies the interrupted route that the loaded craft restores. This materializes path-taking and livelihood travel as engineered passage, while showing how binding can turn unstable water from barrier into support.

parent_channels.name: S8. Whole Surah - Practice Archery and the Stray Arrow
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An archer handles a bow, trains at close range with a short unpointed arrow, and confronts the danger of a shot whose source or direction is unknown.
parent_channels.active_motifs: the curved working section of a bow (`quranic:root_000957:B008/m01`); a short arrow (`quranic:root_000563:B011/m01`); a small unpointed, featherless practice arrow (`quranic:root_001285:B004/m01`); close range that enables a hit (`quranic:root_001285:B002/m01`); a stray arrow of unknown origin (`quranic:root_001077:B013/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Bow, training projectile, distance, successful aim, and uncontrolled shot occupy distinct roles in one range scene. It materializes the surah’s casting and sending of speech as directed delivery, while the anonymous stray arrow usefully pressures hostile or irresponsible saying as force detached from accountable origin.

parent_channels.name: S9. Whole Surah - Milking, Aging, and Thickening a Drink
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Milk is expressed, retained in a vessel, allowed to mature or thicken, blended, reduced, diluted, and tasted.
parent_channels.active_motifs: milking with the fingertips (`quranic:root_001165:B005/m01`); a vessel in which drink is kept for days until it improves (`quranic:root_000067:B010/m01`); milk, honey, or another liquid thickening at its outcome (`quranic:root_000067:B005/m01`); a thick mixture of honey or milk (`quranic:root_000906:B015/m01`); reducing a drink until one third remains (`quranic:root_000203:B008/m01`); diluting a strong drink with water (`quranic:root_001200:B007/m01`); tasting and consuming (`quranic:root_000934:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Collection, waiting, thickening, blending, reduction, dilution, and tasting form a controlled transformation. This usefully reframes measured time and deferred outcome as processes that can mature nourishment, while sharply contrasting the surah’s choking food, whose material transformation defeats intake.

parent_channels.name: S10. Whole Surah - Mountain Refuge for a Wild Herd
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Wild animals enter mountain terrain, where a returning ibex, its mother-and-young pair, a gathered herd, and a neighboring hyena occupy a protected refuge.
parent_channels.active_motifs: entering mountain country (`quranic:root_000217:B006/m01`); a male ibex or stag returning to mountain shelter (`quranic:root_000067:B009/m01`); an ibex mother and young (`quranic:root_001096:B005/m01`); a herd of wild cattle or camels (`quranic:root_000532:B014/m01`); a male hyena (`quranic:root_001040:B007/m01`); a protective barrier around vulnerable life (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Terrain, entry, sheltering adult, mother and young, herd, neighboring animal, and barrier make the mountain a lived refuge rather than inert mass. This materially raises the stakes of 73:14: when mountains become poured sand, an ecological shelter and nursery also disappear.

parent_channels.name: S11. Whole Surah - Receiving and Feeding a Stranger
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A road traveler enters a community not their own, is greeted, lodged in a fitting place, fed, and treated generously.
parent_channels.active_motifs: an outsider entering a people to whom he does not belong (`quranic:root_000009:B006/m01`); road users and travelers (`quranic:root_000672:B002/m01`); conveying a formal greeting (`quranic:root_001211:B006/m01`); a place agreeing with its guest and making lodging pleasant (`quranic:root_001525:B011/m01`); feeding another in response to need (`quranic:root_000934:B002/m01`); generosity and donation (`quranic:root_000452:B005/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Arrival establishes strangerhood, greeting opens relation, lodging supplies safety, and food and gift complete reception. This materializes the surah’s travelers, giving, and mercy as hospitality to a mobile outsider rather than value transfer in the abstract.

parent_channels.name: S12. Whole Surah - Crooked Setting of a Broken Bone
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A hard bone or thick limb is broken, set, and healed on a bend that leaves the body visibly altered.
parent_channels.active_motifs: solid bone (`quranic:root_001029:B005/m01`); the thick part of a limb (`quranic:root_001029:B003/m01`); bodily and skeletal thickness (`quranic:root_000217:B003/m01`); setting a fracture that heals crooked (`quranic:root_000015:B002/m01`); a disfigured form or face (`quranic:root_000832:B002/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Bone, limb, break, setting, healing, and residual deformation form a complete repair scene. The fracture-setting activation of `أَجْرًا` usefully reframes reward as restorative work, while crooked healing presses the surah’s concern with measured uprightness: repair must restore alignment, not merely close a break.

parent_channels.name: S13. Whole Surah - Preparing a Bed and Lying Supine
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A thick wool rug is spread and softened into bedding, after which the occupant relaxes and lies on the back.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a thick woolen rug (`quranic:root_000025:B005/m01`); smoothing a bed or seat until it is soft and easy (`quranic:root_001659:B002/m01`); ease, familiarity, and relaxed confidence (`quranic:root_000563:B007/m01`); lying flat on the back (`quranic:root_001372:B009/m01`); bodily standing (`quranic:root_001273:B002/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Rug, preparation, bodily ease, reclining, and standing create a precise posture contrast. The scene materializes the rest interrupted by the command to rise at night, making nocturnal discipline a bodily refusal of a fully prepared place of repose.

parent_channels.name: S14. Whole Surah - Separating and Grafting a Palm
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A palm offshoot is separated, a young plant receives material from another tree, and successful union is tested against continued greenness or drying.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a palm offshoot separated from its mother (`quranic:root_000082:B004/m01`); young or short palms (`quranic:root_000248:B006/m01`); inserting a branch from another tree and its accepting the union (`quranic:root_000934:B010/m01`); a plant that remains green (`quranic:root_000532:B012/m01`); a dried tree (`quranic:root_000217:B008/m01`); organic growth and increase (`quranic:root_000637:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Separation, young stock, graft insertion, acceptance, growth, and drying form a propagation scene with a success condition. It usefully pressures `تَبَتَّلْ`: severance need not mean sterile isolation, because a cut relation can prepare a viable new attachment whose truth is shown by continued growth.

parent_channels.name: S15. Whole Surah - Task Fee Weighed in an Active Market
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A task is commissioned for a stated fee, the market supplies exchange, and payment is weighed and delivered as wage.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a market becoming active and saleable (`quranic:root_001273:B018/m01`); a fee or bounty assigned to a task (`quranic:root_000248:B005/m01`); the ounce as a known weight for dirhams or oil (`quranic:root_001677:B004/m01`); wage or reward for work (`quranic:root_000015:B001/m01`); silver, gold, or a precious vessel (`quranic:root_001077:B018/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Commission, market, standard weight, payment material, and wage make a complete piecework transaction. This materializes the surah’s `أَجْرًا` as measured compensation while clarifying, by contrast, that the good loan and almsgiving exceed an ordinary fee-for-service exchange.

parent_channels.name: S16. Whole Surah - Sworn and Documented Right
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A right is written, secured by covenant and surety, attested by a witness, and defended against repeated diminution.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a written deed or document of right (`quranic:root_000516:B008/m01`); oath and sworn undertaking (`quranic:root_000076:B007/m01`); knowledgeable testimony (`quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`); covenant and protected agreement (`quranic:root_000532:B011/m01`); surety for another (`quranic:root_001332:B003/m01`); repeated subtraction from another’s right (`quranic:root_001542:B005/m01`)
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 73:3 `ٱنقُصْ`; 73:8,19 `ٱذْكُرِ/تَذْكِرَةٌ`; 73:15 `شَٰهِدًا`; 73:14,18,20 `كَانَتِ/كَانَ/يَكُونُ`; 73:19-20 `رَبِّهِ/رَبَّكَ`; surface anchor unavailable for `quranic:root_000076:B007` because `ء ل ي` is missing from root coverage
parent_channels.synthesis: Record, oath, covenant, guarantor, witness, and threatened diminution fill the roles of a legal assurance scene. It materially supports the surah’s promise, testimony, loan, and accountability by showing how a future obligation is made durable and how partial erosion can still violate the whole right.

parent_channels.name: S17. Whole Surah - Evil Eye and Binding Incantation
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A hostile gaze is perceived to strike a person, visible eye symptoms appear, and an incantation or charm is used to seize or restrain the affliction.
parent_channels.active_motifs: injury by the evil eye (`quranic:root_001533:B003/m01`); an incantation believed to seize the eye (`quranic:root_000018:B004/m01`); an inflamed or jutting eye (`quranic:root_000225:B003/m01`); an eye-film like woven threads (`quranic:root_000672:B010/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Gaze, struck person, eye symptom, obscuring film, and binding rite form a complete culturally legible affliction scene. It usefully pressures the surah’s seizure and protection language by materializing how harm may be imagined as entering through perception and being answered by an act of restraint.

parent_channels.name: S18. Whole Surah - Courtship, Verification, and Blocked Marriage
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A widowed or divorced woman receives suitors, courtship proceeds through message and self-presentation, her status is verified by waiting, and marriage may advance to consummation or be blocked by a charm.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a widowed or divorced woman approached by suitors (`quranic:root_000563:B009/m01`); self-presentation or entreaty in courtship (`quranic:root_001200:B004/m01`); seclusion until menstruation verifies status (`quranic:root_001210:B010/m01`); a charm believed to restrain marriage or judgment (`quranic:root_000018:B004/m02`); the night of consummation (`quranic:root_000833:B003/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Separation, renewed approach, message, waiting test, blocking device, and consummation define a regulated relational transition. The scene usefully reframes the surah’s severance and delay by showing that social withdrawal can initiate a timed reordering of attachment rather than simple abandonment.

parent_channels.name: S19. Whole Surah - Pasture Greening, Grazing, and Abandonment
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A gentle wind moves over persistent greenery, herd animals graze a named forage, and the vegetation eventually dries, breaks, and is left behind.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a gentle moist south wind (`quranic:root_001525:B009/m01`); a plant that remains green (`quranic:root_000532:B012/m01`); camel forage called `الصِّليان` (`quranic:root_000879:B009/m01`); a herd of wild cattle or camels (`quranic:root_000532:B014/m01`); a dried tree (`quranic:root_000217:B008/m01`); dry pasture broken by livestock or abandoned by the herder (`quranic:root_001578:B010/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Wind, green plant, forage, herd, drying, breakage, and abandonment create a full pasture cycle. It materializes bounty as an ecology vulnerable to exhaustion and usefully pressures the earth-and-mountain convulsion as the destruction of provision over time, not only sudden geology.

parent_channels.name: S20. Whole Surah - Shaped Timber Eroded by Termites
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Timber is cut into a supporting frame, dries in service, and is consumed from within by termites until its load-bearing integrity is lost.
parent_channels.active_motifs: wooden tent supports or a carrying frame (`quranic:root_000067:B008/m01`); an adze for shaping wood (`quranic:root_001207:B008/m01`); dried timber (`quranic:root_000217:B008/m01`); termites that eat wood (`quranic:root_000025:B010/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Tool, shaped support, drying material, hidden consumer, and structural loss form a compact failure process. It usefully reframes the surah’s collapsing supports: apparent solidity may already be hollowed internally before visible rupture or pouring begins.

parent_channels.name: S21. Whole Surah - Counting Remembrance With Beads
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A worshiper names and remembers the divine referent while moving beads to count repeated utterances.
parent_channels.active_motifs: beads used to count glorification (`quranic:root_000666:B006/m01`); verbal mention (`quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`); name as designation (`quranic:root_000745:B005/m01`); worship and the worshiped one (`quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`); exhaustive counting (`quranic:root_000332:B002/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Worshiper, named referent, repeated mention, counting instrument, and tally form a complete devotional practice. It directly materializes “remember the name” and presses the later admission that the night cannot be exhaustively counted: a finite instrument can order repetitions without mastering divine temporal measure.

parent_channels.name: S22. Whole Surah - Pebble-in-Hand Odd-or-Even Game
parent_channels.scene_or_process: One player hides pebbles in a closed hand, another calls odd or even, and opening and counting the hand resolves the guess.
parent_channels.active_motifs: small pebbles used as counters (`quranic:root_000332:B001/m01`); an object concealed in the palm (`quranic:root_000637:B005/m01`); the game-call asking pair or odd (`quranic:root_000637:B005/m02`); resolution into an even pair or an odd count (`quranic:root_000637:B005/m03`); exhaustive enumeration (`quranic:root_000332:B002/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Counters, concealment, binary call, exposure, and enumeration supply the full mechanics of a hand game. It usefully reframes the surah’s fractions and failed counting through a tactile contrast: hidden quantity can invite estimation, but only disclosure and enumeration settle the amount.

parent_channels.name: S23. Whole Surah - Saddle and Tack Assembly
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A wooden saddle frame is fitted with twisted cord and hanging straps, trimmed with a leatherworker’s blade, and balanced for rider and pillion.
parent_channels.active_motifs: the wooden frame of a saddle (`quranic:root_001029:B009/m01`); rope twisted from three strands (`quranic:root_000203:B004/m01`); a hanging leather strap or cord (`quranic:root_000994:B006/m01`); a shoemaker’s or leatherworker’s blade (`quranic:root_000644:B008/m01`); pillion and balanced riding (`quranic:root_000644:B002/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Frame, cord, strap, cutting tool, rider, and pillion form a complete tack-making and load-balancing scene. It materializes the wrapped load-bearer and long travel by showing the crafted apparatus that distributes weight, while the three-strand cord gives numerical partition a structural function.

parent_channels.name: S24. Whole Surah - Cutting Honor With Speech
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A sharp-tongued speaker rebukes, insults, backbites, and repeatedly diminishes another person’s social standing.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a cutting or biting tongue (`quranic:root_000332:B004/m01`); backbiting and false accusation that cut another’s honor (`quranic:root_001217:B006/m01`); disparagement and verbal detraction (`quranic:root_001542:B003/m01`); harsh verbal rebuke (`quranic:root_001559:B004/m01`); an abusive sexualized slur (`quranic:root_001638:B004/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Tongue, rebuke, slur, backbiting, and cumulative loss of standing constitute a specific social-injury process. It materializes “what they say” as repeated cutting of honor and thereby strengthens the force of beautiful withdrawal as refusal to answer injury with a matching verbal wound.

parent_channels.name: S25. Whole Surah - Early Departure to a Sunlit Prayer Ground
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A worshiper departs early, reaches an exposed place associated with sunrise or festival prayer, invokes God, and performs the prescribed prayer.
parent_channels.active_motifs: going early to Friday prayer or another appointed gathering (`quranic:root_001578:B006/m01`); a sunlit sitting place or festival prayer ground (`quranic:root_000790:B006/m01`); prescribed prayer (`quranic:root_000879:B003/m01`); invoking the name of God (`quranic:root_000047:B002/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Early departure, timed place, invocation, and prayer form a complete public ritual itinerary. It supports the surah’s movement from measured night practice into maintained prayer by materializing punctual devotion as travel toward a light-defined communal site.

parent_channels.name: S26. Whole Surah - Caravan Watering in Midday Heat
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Travelers reach a large basin during severe midday heat, drink life-sustaining water in measured breaths, and water their camels.
parent_channels.active_motifs: road users and travelers (`quranic:root_000672:B002/m01`); severe midday heat and travel through it (`quranic:root_001578:B005/m01`); a large built water basin (`quranic:root_001578:B011/m01`); water that sustains life and restores breath (`quranic:root_001533:B008/m01`); the sound of camel lips taking water (`quranic:root_000833:B004/m01`); a sip or breath of drinking (`quranic:root_001533:B006/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Heat, road party, basin, reviving water, measured human intake, and camel drinking complete a caravan-watering scene. It materializes the surah’s livelihood travel and merciful accommodation as bodily preservation, while reversing the choking meal with water that restores rather than obstructs breath.

parent_channels.name: Measured Demand Becomes Sustainable Communal Practice
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A measured obligation remains binding while its quantity and mode are adjusted to the real capacity of those performing it.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; P1 73:2-6 supplies `قُمِ`, `قَلِيلًا`, `نِّصْفَهُ`, `ٱنقُصْ`, `زِدْ`, and `رَتِّلِ`; P2 73:20 supplies `تَقُومُ`, `ثُلُثَىِ`, `نِصْفَهُ`, `ثُلُثَهُ`, `يُقَدِّرُ`, `لَّن تُحْصُوهُ`, and `مَا تَيَسَّرَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The closing concession does not cancel the opening formation; it completes its measurement logic by treating human limitation as evidence relevant to the measure itself.

parent_channels.name: The Cast Saying Advances Into Witnessed Event
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Communication becomes accountable as it moves from formed utterance, to delivered message, to witnessed reception, and finally to enacted truth.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; P1 73:4-6 supplies `ٱلْقُرْءَانَ`, `نُلْقِى`, `قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا`, and `قِيلًا`; P2 73:15-18 supplies `أَرْسَلْنَا`, `رَسُولًا شَٰهِدًا`, `عَصَىٰ`, and `كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَفْعُولًا`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The message does not merely recur in P2; it changes evidentiary role, moving from material borne by a recipient to the standard by which response and event are established.

parent_channels.name: Human Release Transfers the Affair to Divine Custody
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Severance becomes viable when the released affair passes into a custody capable of sustaining responsibility and completing its outcome.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; P1 73:8-10 supplies `تَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ`, `فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا`, and `ٱهْجُرْهُمْ`; P2 73:11 supplies `وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ`, while 73:19 returns to `ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The abrupt shift from “leave them” to “leave Me with them” specifies the new holder of the relation and prevents withdrawal from being read as unowned abandonment.

parent_channels.name: Ethical Restraint and Bounded Reprieve Share a Form but Not an Outcome
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Withholding immediate reaction creates a temporal interval whose meaning depends on what the interval is for.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; P1 73:10 supplies `ٱصْبِرْ` and `ٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا`; P2 73:11 supplies `مَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا`, and 73:18 closes the interval with `كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَفْعُولًا`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Patience and delay are not collapsed into passivity: the same withholding form protects moral proportion in one pericope and preserves the certainty of timed judgment in the other.

parent_channels.name: Carried Formation Reverses Into Inescapable Closure
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Pressure either becomes a voluntarily stabilized burden or an externally imposed condition that closes movement and intake.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; P1 73:1-5 supplies `ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ`, `قُمِ`, and `قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا`; P2 73:12-13 supplies `أَنكَالًا`, `جَحِيمًا`, `طَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ`, and `عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The surah distributes heaviness according to response: formative weight can be borne and integrated, whereas rejected address returns as an environment that prevents ordinary bodily passage.

parent_channels.name: Controlled Waterwork Reverses Into Boundary Failure
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Flow remains productive only while source, channel, vessel, boundary, and outlet keep their assigned roles.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; P1 73:5-9 supplies the activating roots in `نُلْقِى`, `سَبْحًا`, `رَبِّكَ`, and `ٱلْمَغْرِبِ`; P2 73:14,18-20 supplies `ٱلْأَرْضُ`, `ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌ`, `سَبِيلًا`, and `فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Cosmic instability is reframed through ordinary water management: disaster is not water as a topic but the loss of differentiated hydraulic functions.

parent_channels.name: The Recurring Horizon Clock Narrows Into an Appointment
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Observable position makes time legible, but recurring cycles can also point toward an event that will not recur as ordinary day and night do.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; P1 73:2,7,9 supplies `ٱلَّيْلَ`, `ٱلنَّهَارِ`, `ٱلْمَشْرِقِ`, and `ٱلْمَغْرِبِ`; P2 73:14,17-18 supplies `يَوْمَ`, `يَوْمًا`, and `وَعْدُهُ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The final day is not linked to ordinary time by topic alone; both pericopes use position, interval, and visible marker to make an otherwise absent time operationally knowable.

parent_channels.name: Daytime Roaming Divides Into Livelihood and Combat Routes
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Open daytime movement acquires moral and social definition from the purpose pursued along its route.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; P1 73:7 supplies `فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا`; P2 73:20 supplies `يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ` and `يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: P2 answers what the long daytime “swim” contains by assigning its travelers different objectives, risks, and forms of return.

parent_channels.name: Ordinary Maturation Is Compressed Into Catastrophic Aging
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Life normally advances through reproductive preparation, gestation, birth, upbringing, and visible maturation; catastrophe collapses those separated stages.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect in P1 and direct in P2; P1 73:5-6 supplies `ثَقِيلًا` and `نَاشِئَةَ`, while P2 73:17 supplies `يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: P2’s child-to-grey image becomes catastrophic precisely because P1 supplies the distributed biological and social duration that the image deletes.

parent_channels.name: Inward Saying Is Tested by Public Denial and Assent
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Speech becomes accountable when inward appropriation, public utterance, and durable response either correspond or diverge.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; P1 73:5-6,10 supplies `قَوْلًا`, `قِيلًا`, and `مَا يَقُولُونَ`; P2 73:11,16-17 supplies `ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ`, `عَصَىٰ ... ٱلرَّسُولَ`, and `كَفَرْتُمْ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The bridge distinguishes opposition from a second failure mode: words and gestures may appear compliant while allegiance remains opportunistic.

parent_channels.name: Named Remembrance Becomes Maintained Service and Care
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Devotion persists when remembered designation, embodied practice, sustaining authority, and outward transfer remain joined.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; P1 73:2,4,8-9 supplies `قُمِ`, `ٱلْقُرْءَانَ`, `ٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ`, and `وَكِيلًا`; P2 73:20 supplies `أَقِيمُوا ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ`, `ءَاتُوا ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ`, `أَقْرِضُوا ٱللَّهَ`, and `رَّحِيمٌ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The closing acts are not a list added to private remembrance; they are its institutional and interpersonal continuation.

parent_channels.name: Stored Value Advances, Circulates, and Returns Enlarged
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Value is assessed and preserved so it can move through livelihood, contribution, and reciprocal return without losing its accountable measure.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect in P1 and direct in P2; P1 73:2-7 supplies the quantity, weight, increase, and travel activators in `قَلِيلًا`, `نِّصْفَهُ`, `زِدْ`, `ثَقِيلًا`, and `سَبْحًا`; P2 73:20 supplies `فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ`, `ءَاتُوا`, `أَقْرِضُوا`, `تُقَدِّمُوا`, `تَجِدُوهُ`, and `أَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Preservation and circulation are joined by operation rather than a broad “provision” topic: what is measured and stored becomes capable of travel, gift, advance, and accountable return.

parent_channels.name: Ethical Proportion Reverses the Value of Luxury
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Visible quality receives its true value from proportionate conduct rather than rank, comfort, or enlarged display.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect but strongly anchored; P1 73:3,6,10 supplies `نِّصْفَهُ`, `أَقْوَمُ`, and `هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا`; P2 73:11 supplies `أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ`, followed by the punitive reversal of 73:12-14.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Beauty and luxury are not parallel positive topics. The pericopes reverse their valuation by testing whether visible excellence is governed by proportion or detached from it.

parent_channels.name: Constructed Covering Reverses Into Exposure
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A cover protects only while material, boundary, and moral function remain intact; rupture changes the covered interior into an exposed object.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect in P1 and direct in P2; P1 73:1,3,7-9 supplies `ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ`, `نِّصْفَهُ`, `سَبْحًا`, and `رَبِّكَ`; P2 73:17-20 supplies `تَتَّقُونَ`, `كَفَرْتُمْ`, `ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌ`, and `غَفُورٌ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The wrapped figure and ruptured sky occupy opposite ends of one boundary operation, while disbelief and forgiveness show that concealment can either corrupt or protect.

parent_channels.name: Bodily Distress Advances From Symptom to Accommodation
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Involuntary bodily signs become ethically relevant when they are recognized as impairment, placed under care, and allowed to modify demanded action.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect in P1 and direct in P2; P1 73:5-6 supplies `ثَقِيلًا`, `أَشَدُّ`, and `وَطْـًٔا`; P2 73:14,17,20 supplies `تَرْجُفُ`, `شِيبًا`, `مَرْضَىٰ`, and `مَا تَيَسَّرَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The closing accommodation is grounded in a chain of bodily evidence rather than generalized leniency.

parent_channels.name: Interpersonal Grappling Scales Into Organized Capture
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Conflict advances from direct bodily contest through coordinated engagement to capture, subjugation, and mortal outcome.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect in P1 and direct in P2; P1 73:5-6,9-10 supplies `ثَقِيلًا`, `أَشَدُّ`, `فَٱتَّخِذْهُ`, and `ٱصْبِرْ`; P2 73:12,16,20 supplies `أَنكَالًا`, `أَخَذْنَٰهُ`, `يَضْرِبُونَ`, and `يُقَٰتِلُونَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: War is not joined to grappling by violence as a topic; both scenes preserve the same roles of opposing agent, controlled limb, applied force, lost mobility, and terminal custody.

parent_channels.name: Patterned Recitation Is Contrasted With Fabricated Composition
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Verbal form can follow a disciplined model that stabilizes recurrence or manufacture an artifact without truthful correspondence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; P1 73:4,6 supplies `ٱلْقُرْءَانَ`, `تَرْتِيلًا`, and `وَطْـًٔا`; P2 73:18,20 supplies `مَفْعُولًا`, `ٱقْرَءُوا`, `ٱلْقُرْءَانِ`, `قَرْضًا`, and `يَضْرِبُونَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Formal resemblance is not treated as proof of truth; the same capacity to model and compose can support disciplined recitation or produce a persuasive counterfeit.

parent_channels.name: Firm Night Footing Reverses Into Cosmic Loss of Support
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Stability depends on pressure finding a resistant support and boundaries remaining intact; judgment removes both conditions.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; P1 73:6 supplies `أَشَدُّ وَطْـًٔا وَأَقْوَمُ`; P2 73:14 supplies `تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ` and `كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا`, while 73:18 supplies `ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Uprightness and cosmic collapse are connected by mechanics rather than opposition as a loose theme: one scene stabilizes contact under force, while the other removes resistance below and enclosure above.
